abstract: Although vision-language-action (VLA) models have received widespread attention, many challenges remain in manipulating dynamic moving objects. In most existing approaches, end-to-end forward or inverse dynamics models, i.e., world models, are incorporated into high-performance base VLA architectures, which may degrade the performance of well-pretrained base VLA models due to inappropriate fine-tuning. In this paper, we propose DynaWM, a base-VLA-guided world foundation model that adapts to a wide variety of fine-tuned and coarse-tuned base-VLA checkpoints for moving-object manipulation. DynaWM uses a Mamba-3-based action encoder to encode the base action chunk produced by the base VLA into an action-conditioning representation, a V-JEPA 2.1 vision encoder to extract features from multi-view observation history, and a proprioceptive state encoder to encode robotic-arm proprioceptive states. These feature representations jointly condition a flow-matching DiT to regenerate motion-aware action trajectories for moving-object manipulation. For systematic evaluation, we construct the DynaGrasp-32 benchmark, covering six categories of moving-object manipulation tasks, including velocity variation, trajectory variation, and multi-object manipulation, as well as the DynaGrasp-1600 dataset, which consists of 32 scenarios, 1,600 demonstration trajectories, and approximately 1.53M images. For fine-tuned base-VLA checkpoints, DynaWM achieves percentage improvements of 7.19, 45.31, 1.88, and 10.94 over SmolVLA, X-VLA, π0, and π0.5, respectively. For coarse-tuned base-VLA checkpoints, performance increases by 35.13, 44.06, 35.69, and 26.13 percentage, respectively. Ablation experiments show that visual encoding enhances success by 27.50%, while reducing success by 45.44% if action conditioning is removed.

title: UniTacVLA: Unified Tactile Understanding and Prediction in Vision Language Action Models
titleZh: UniTacVLA：在视觉—语言—动作模型中统一触觉理解与预测
oneLiner: UniTacVLA 不再把触觉当作附加输入，而是联合推理当前接触状态、预测未来触觉，并以高频触觉闭环修正 VLA 的低频动作块。
researchQuestion: 视觉难以在遮挡下观察接触开始、滑动、卡住和细微对齐误差，而常见 VLA 又以低频、近似开环的动作块执行任务。已有 VTLA 方法通常只把触觉编码成额外 token，没有显式理解接触阶段或预测接触变化。论文研究如何让触觉同时参与语义推理、未来动力学预测和实时控制。
contribution: 相比简单多模态拼接，这篇工作把触觉提升为预测和闭环控制信号，回答了触觉如何真正改变动作，而不仅是如何输入 VLA。它代表 VLA 向接触丰富任务扩展时值得关注的一条技术路线。
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in many robotic manipulation tasks, yet remain limited in contact-rich dexterous manipulation. To overcome this limitation, recent vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) methods incorporate tactile sensing into VLA models to provide direct contact information. However, they typically treat tactile signals as passive auxiliary inputs, making it difficult to model tactile semantics and future physical interactions. To this end, we
selectionReason: Interesting tactile VLA framework that moves beyond passive tactile inputs to active tactile understanding and prediction. Tactile chain-of-thought and mixed controller are novel. Real-world experiments across 4 task categories. However, no code and the approach builds heavily on existing VLA architectures.

title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
titleZh: Z-1：面向视觉—语言—动作模型的高效强化学习
oneLiner: Z-1 为基于流的 VLA 设计共享前缀 GRPO、树状 rollout 和完成度奖励，使 π0.5 在 24 个 RoboCasa 任务上的平均成功率由 67.4% 提升到 80.6%。
researchQuestion: 监督微调只能复制固定示范，无法从策略自己的失败中改进。把语言模型的 GRPO 直接用于连续动作 VLA 又会遭遇 rollout 成本高、稀疏成功奖励和视觉骨干不稳定。论文研究如何针对 flow-based VLA 构造更高效的在线 RL 后训练。
contribution: Z-1 说明 VLA 后训练不一定需要私有大规模示范，策略自身 rollout 也能带来显著收益；更重要的是，它给出了连续控制中如何组织 GRPO 数据的具体工程设计。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising framework for robotic manipulation by connecting language instructions, visual observations, and continuous control. However, most existing policies remain limited by behavior cloning or supervised fine-tuning (SFT) from fixed demonstrations, which provides limited opportunity to improve from the policy's own failures. In this paper, we present Z-1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework for flow-based VLA models. Built on top
selectionReason: 系统性地将GRPO应用于基于流的VLA模型（π0.5）后训练，仅用公开数据实现显著性能提升。核心贡献：(1)共享前缀rollout构建+树结构轨迹分支提升在线优化效率；(2)完成度感知奖励校准；(3)VLM和Action Expert选择性联合训练。在24个RoboCasa任务上80.6%成功率，较SFT提升13.2个百分点。展示了RL后训练对VLA的重要价值。主要风险：仅仿真评估（RoboCasa），无真实机器人验证；仅基于π0.5单一模型。

title: CoDex: Learning Compositional Dexterous Functional Manipulation without Demonstrations
titleZh: CoDex：无示范学习组合式灵巧功能操作
oneLiner: CoDex 让 VLM 先推断功能物体的语义约束，再以解析抓取和仿真 RL 自主发现抓取—搬运—触发策略，在六项真实任务上达到 73% 总体成功率。
researchQuestion: 喷瓶、胶枪或研磨器不仅要被抓住，还要保持特定朝向、驱动内部机构，并把功能作用到目标区域。普通抓取数据不包含这些组合约束，人工示范又难以为大量新工具采集。论文研究机器人能否从视觉语义和物体模型出发，在没有任务示范的情况下自行生成训练信号。
contribution: CoDex 展示了“语义规划产生训练约束、物理 RL 负责把约束做成动作”的分工。它是减少功能性灵巧操作示范依赖的一条有潜力路线。
abstract: In this work, we study Compositional Dexterous Functional Object Manipulation (CD-FOM): tasks such as aiming and actuating a spray bottle on a plant or a glue gun on wood, which require both actuating an object's internal mechanism and controlling its pose to apply the object's function to the environment. These tasks pose significant challenges for robots due to the demanding integration of semantic understanding of the object's function, actuation mode, and application area with intricate phys
selectionReason: 首次实现零演示的灵巧功能性操作——机器人自主发现如何抓取并操作喷瓶、胶枪、手电筒等功能性物体，无需人类演示数据。核心贡献：(1)CD-FOM任务定义（组合灵巧功能性物体操作）；(2)VLM推断语义约束→解析约束优化生成功能抓取；(3)RL生成完整策略并sim-to-real迁移。6个任务在真实机器人验证。零演示特性具有重要扩展价值。主要风险：依赖VLM语义推理质量，任务物体种类有限。

title: OopsieVerse: A Safety Benchmark with Damage-Aware Simulation for Robot Manipulation
titleZh: OopsieVerse：面向机器人操作安全的损伤感知仿真基准
oneLiner: OopsieVerse构建了首个损伤感知的家居操作仿真框架和基准，通过建模机械、热和流体三类损伤，将安全信号纳入MDP，32项任务覆盖多种损伤模式，支持安全演示采集、安全策略学习和VLA安全基准测试。
researchQuestion: 机器人操作能力快速进步，但物理安全仍是部署家用机器人的主要障碍——任务成功不足以说明问题，如果机器人在过程中损坏自身或环境则不可接受。现有仿真器缺乏通用机制来检测、量化和表示损伤，导致操作基准仅以目标完成为成功标准，不区分安全和不安全的行为。
contribution: 填补了机器人操作安全性评估的系统性空白。与依赖任务特定奖励塑形或手工约束的传统方法不同，DamageSim提供通用、可扩展的损伤信号。开源跨平台设计有望成为安全机器人研究的标准化基础工具。
abstract: While robotic manipulation capabilities have advanced rapidly, physical safety remains a major barrier to deploying household robots: task success is insufficient if the robot damages itself or its surroundings. Simulation offers a harm-free alternative to costly and dangerous real-world training and evaluation, yet existing simulators lack general mechanisms to detect, quantify, and represent damage. To address this gap, we introduce OOPSIEVERSE, a unified simulation framework and benchmark for
selectionReason: 首个系统性地将物理安全（损伤检测、量化、表征）引入机器人操作仿真基准的工作。核心贡献：(1)DamageSim——仿真器无关框架，将接触力/温度/液体交互转化为机械/热/流体损伤信号；(2)MDP增强——损伤作为观测/奖励/终止条件的显式信号；(3)完整家庭任务套件评估常见损伤模式；(4)跨两个仿真器（OmniGibson+RoboCasa）实例化及多用例验证。填补了看板上机器人安全评估这一关键空白。相较于现有基准（SIMPLE、LIBERO等），OopsieVerse首次将安全从二元的成功/失败拓展到损伤感知的连续评估。主要风险：损伤模型简化（基于物理量阈值），未考虑长期累积损伤。

title: Human-as-Humanoid: Enabling Zero-Shot Humanoid Learning from Ego-Exo Human Videos with Human-Aligned Embodiments
titleZh: Human-as-Humanoid：用内外视角人类视频实现零样本人形学习
oneLiner: 论文通过与人体结构对齐的 60 自由度 PrimeU、同步内外视角视频和运动学监督，把人类动作近实时转换为人形 VLA 可执行的观察—动作训练对。
researchQuestion: 高自由度人形机器人缺少规模化动作监督。第一视角人类视频丰富，却没有机器人关节动作；直接姿态重定向还会因形态和接触差异产生不可执行标签。论文探索一种硬件与算法协同路线：先让机器人结构尽量贴近人，再把人类视频系统性转换为机器人动作。
contribution: 它把跨形态问题部分转化为“设计更接近人的机器人”，并提供从视频到动作监督的完整链路。对人形数据扩展而言，这是重要基础设施思路，但硬件依赖也意味着推广成本较高。
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models across robot embodiments require high-quality observation--action supervision to learn deployable action distributions, yet scaling such robot data remains difficult, especially for high-DoF humanoids. Teleoperation provides controller-aligned supervision, while human egocentric videos capture diverse bimanual manipulation but do not directly provide executable robot actions. We introduce Human-as-Humanoid, a human-to-humanoid supervision framework that enable
organizations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
selectionReason: 解决人形机器人VLA训练数据稀缺的关键瓶颈——将大规模人类egocentric视频转化为可执行的人形机器人监督。核心贡献：(1)人类对齐的PrimeU 60-DoF人形平台；(2)Ego-exo同步视频配对+分阶段IK运动重定向管线；(3)FK感知监督保留手腕和指尖任务空间几何。将人类数据规模化利用于人形机器人训练，具有重要基础设施价值。

title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
titleZh: ASPIRE：机器人自主技能编程与发现
oneLiner: ASPIRE是一个持续学习系统，在代码即策略范式中自主编写和精炼机器人控制程序，同时将经验累积为可复用技能库。在LIBERO-Pro操作、Robosuite双臂交接和BEHAVIOR-1K长时域家居任务上分别超越先前方法77%、72%和32%，技能库支持零样本泛化至未见长时域任务（31% vs 4%）。
researchQuestion: 传统机器人编程面临三大挑战：协调多模态感知、管理物理接触动力学、处理多样化配置和执行故障。现有方法要么依赖人工编写控制程序，要么仅在单轨迹层面优化，缺乏从经验中持续学习和跨任务复用知识的机制。
contribution: ASPIRE从"一次性编程"转向"持续技能发现"范式，技能库的累积和复用机制为机器人自主能力增长提供了可扩展路径。进化搜索+LLM代码生成+闭环验证的组合范式在多个基准上的巨大提升令人印象深刻。
abstract: Traditional robot programming is challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE discovers skills that persist across tas
selectionReason: Autonomous skill programming system from top labs (Yuke Zhu, Ajay Mandlekar, Ken Goldberg, Jim Fan, Guanya Shi) that compounds experience into reusable skill libraries with strong sim-to-real results across multiple benchmarks.

title: X-Morph: Human Motion Priors for Scalable Robot Learning Across Morphologies
titleZh: X-Morph：利用人类运动先验扩展跨形态机器人学习
oneLiner: X-Morph 将人类运动重定向到四足、六足和带机械臂四足平台，再以特权 RL 跟踪并蒸馏为因果策略，用于视频遥操作、行为先验和文本动作生成。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人可以直接利用大量人体动作，但非人形腿式平台缺少同等规模的运动数据。简单建立关节对应会产生视觉上像、动力学上不可跟踪的参考，也难以在实时视频输入下运行。论文研究如何保留人类动作意图，同时生成适应不同机器人形态的可执行运动先验。
contribution: X-Morph 把人体动作看作“行为语义库”，而非只能用于人形的关节轨迹。若真实迁移成立，它可显著扩大非人形腿式机器人的预训练数据来源。
abstract: Recent progress in humanoid behavior models has been driven in large part by abundant human motion data, but comparable motion data is scarce for non-humanoid legged robots such as quadrupeds, hexapods, and quadruped manipulators. A promising alternative is to repurpose human motion across embodiments; however, direct retargeting often produces motions that are visually plausible yet physically inconsistent or difficult to track under robot dynamics. We present X-Morph, a human-motion-to-robot-b
selectionReason: 首次将人类运动数据规模化迁移到非人形足式机器人（四足/六足/四足+臂），突破了人类运动数据仅服务于人形机器人的限制。核心贡献：(1)跨形态运动重定向——保持意图和运动学可行性；(2)特权RL→因果学生蒸馏管线；(3)支持视频遥操作、行为先验和文本条件生成。三种平台验证。从数据扩展角度具有重要价值。主要风险：仅仿真验证（未见真实机器人结果），代码未确认开源。

title: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
titleZh: VLK：从重建场景中的合成交互学习人形机器人移动操作
oneLiner: 提出利用3DGS重建场景+合成交互轨迹自动生成人形机器人训练数据的VLK方法：48,000对自视角图像-语言-运动学轨迹的自动合成，VLK策略预测短时全身运动学轨迹→全身跟踪器执行，在宇树G1上验证导航和物体搬运。
researchQuestion: 基于感知的人形机器人移动操作(loco-manipulation)需要连接自视角观察、任务指令和全身运动。学习这种映射需要同步的自视角图像、语言命令和机器人兼容的运动学轨迹三元组，但现有数据源均无法大规模提供这种完整数据元组。真实人形机器人遥操作数据采集成本极高，而人类视频缺乏机器人兼容的运动学信息。如何在无需人类演示的条件下，为感知驱动的人形机器人移动操作提供有效的训练监督？
contribution: VLK提出了一种创新的数据扩展范式——"在重建场景中合成→在真实机器人上部署"——为人形机器人移动操作的数据瓶颈提供了有前景的解决方案。其核心洞察——感知策略只预测运动学而非直接输出动作，将行为合成与感知解耦——使得行为合成可以充分利用仿真特权信息，是实现sim-to-real的有效策略。3DGS重建+合成交互的pipeline完全自动化，展示了通过合成数据规模化人形机器人学习的可能性。
abstract: Perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation requires connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion. Learning this mapping requires synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories, yet no existing data source provides this complete tuple at scale. We address this bottleneck by generating vision-language-kinematics (VLK) supervision synthetically in reconstructed scenes. Our pipeline leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct metric-scale indoor environments, synthesizes navigation and object-interaction trajectories using privileged scene information, and renders paired egocentric observations after the fact. We produce 48,000 paired trajectories with no human intervention and train a VLK policy that predicts short-horizon whole-body kinematic trajectories. A whole-body tracker converts these predictions into actions on the physical humanoid. We evaluate on the physical Unitree G1 performing navigation and single-object transport, demonstrating that synthesized interactions in reconstructed scenes provide effective supervision for sim-to-real perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation.
selectionReason: 创新性解决人形机器人移动操作数据瓶颈：利用3DGS重建场景+合成交互轨迹，自动生成48,000对自视角图像-语言-运动学轨迹。VLK策略预测全身运动学轨迹→全身跟踪器执行。在宇树G1上验证了导航和物体搬运任务。由合成数据驱动sim-to-real的perception-based人形机器人移动操作。

title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
titleZh: 从抓取到灵巧性：面向灵巧操作的大规模抓取预训练
oneLiner: 论文把 35.5 万条抓取轨迹转化为低层控制预训练，再以高层手部子目标指导工具操作，在 DexCraft 和真实机器人上显著提升少数据灵巧技能。
researchQuestion: 大规模灵巧抓取数据通常只用于生成静态抓姿或抓取搬运，却包含丰富的手—物体接触先验。功能工具使用还要求保持抓持并驱动可动部件，单个端到端策略很难从少量任务示范同时学会稳定抓取和长时控制。论文研究抓取数据能否成为更广泛灵巧操作的预训练资源。
contribution: 这项工作的重要洞察是：已有抓取数据不只是静态姿态库，也可作为接触控制的通用预训练。它为灵巧操作缓解任务数据稀缺提供了比重新采集更经济的路径。
abstract: Large-scale dexterous grasp datasets encode rich priors over hand-object interaction, but their use has largely been confined to grasp generation and pick-and-place manipulation. We study whether such data can instead support functional dexterity in articulated tool use, where a robot must acquire a tool, maintain contact, and operate its functional moving parts. We adapt a hierarchical imitation learning framework that combines high-level hand sub-goal prediction with a low-level goal-condition
selectionReason: 创新性地将大规模抓取数据集（355k轨迹）重新定位为灵巧工具使用的预训练资源——这是对现有抓取数据价值的重要重新发现。核心贡献：(1)层次化IL框架（高层子目标预测+低层目标条件控制）；(2)抓取预训练→任务微调范式；(3)DexCraft基准（6个关节工具使用任务）。真实机器人上较DP3提升33.3个百分点。为灵巧操作的数据扩展提供了新范式。接近featured门槛。

title: Multisensory Continual Learning: Adapting Pretrained Visuomotor Policies to Force
titleZh: MuSe：多传感器持续学习——将预训练视觉运动策略适配至力觉
oneLiner: 提出多传感器持续学习新范式：通过多阶段融合、多传感器未来预测和经验回放，仅用少量力/扭矩演示数据将纯视觉预训练策略扩展至力觉感知。接触密集型任务显著提升（花瓶擦拭5/15→11.5/15），同时改善原有纯视觉任务性能。
researchQuestion: 机器人操作常需力、触觉、声音等超越视觉的感知反馈，但这些模态通常硬件和任务特定，大规模多传感器数据稀缺。因此，为每种传感器都预训练策略不切实际。核心问题：能否将预训练策略适配至新传感器模态和新任务，同时保持原有传感器下的性能（持续学习）？
contribution: 该工作首次系统性地研究了预训练机器人策略的后预训练传感器扩展问题。MuSe证明了少量多传感器数据可以改善策略在预训练分布之外的通用能力。这对规模化部署中逐步引入新传感器具有实际指导意义——不需为每种传感器组合重新预训练。
abstract: Robot manipulation often relies on sensory feedback beyond vision, particularly in contact-rich settings where force, tactile, or audio signals reveal interaction states that are not directly observable from images. However, these modalities are often hardware- and task-specific, and large-scale multisensory robot datasets remain scarce. As a result, it is impractical to pretrain policies with every sensor they may encounter. We study multisensory continual learning: adapting a pretrained robot policy to new tasks with newly introduced modalities while preserving performance under the original sensor suite. We propose MultiSensory World Model (MuSe), which incorporates limited multisensory data into pretrained vision-only policies through multi-stage fusion, multisensory future prediction, and experience replay over pretraining data. We instantiate MuSe by augmenting a pretrained vision-only policy with force-torque sensing and evaluate it on real-world manipulation tasks. Our experiments show that MuSe performs strongly on contact-rich finetuning tasks while preserving, and in some cases improving, performance on the original pretraining tasks. These results suggest that a modest multisensory dataset can improve general robot capabilities beyond the finetuning distribution.
selectionReason: 提出多传感器持续学习新问题：如何将预训练视觉策略适配至新传感器模态而不遗忘原有能力。MuSe通过多阶段融合（早期+晚期）、多传感器未来预测和经验回放三组件，仅用少量力/扭矩演示数据即实现接触密集型任务的显著提升（花瓶擦拭5/15→11.5/15），同时保持甚至改善原有纯视觉任务的性能。为机器人策略的后预训练传感器扩展提供了新范式。

title: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning
titleZh: Human2Any：基于约束感知组合规划的人机技能迁移
oneLiner: 从人类视频中学习物体交互先验，通过约束感知的组合规划和扩散模型采样，实现跨不同机器人形态的零样本操作策略迁移。
researchQuestion: 机器人操作策略的学习高度依赖高质量的机器人遥操作演示数据，采集成本高且难以规模化。人类视频虽然丰富多样，但将其直接迁移到机器人面临三大障碍：(1) 人类与机器人之间的形态差异（embodiment mismatch）；(2) 场景变化（物体几何、布局不同）；(3) 机器人特有的可行性约束（可达性、关节限制、碰撞）。现有方法要么依赖机器人演示数据，要么直接将人类动作映射为机器人动作，难以在测试时灵活适应新场景和非同构机器人形态。
contribution: Human2Any 的核心洞察是：人类视频中可迁移的信号不是人体动作本身，而是物体之间的交互结构。通过将交互运动与机器人执行解耦，该工作为大规模利用非机器人视频数据训练操作策略开辟了道路。其约束感知组合采样的思路在扩散模型时代的 TAMP（任务与运动规划）中也具有参考价值。在 Franka 和人形机器人 RBY-1 上的跨形态验证尤其展示了该方法向多样化硬件泛化的潜力。
abstract: Human videos are a scalable source of supervision for robot manipulation, as they are abundant and naturally capture rich object interactions. However, transferring human demonstrations to robots remains challenging due to embodiment mismatch, scene variation, and robot-specific feasibility constraints. We present Human2Any, a framework for learning reusable object-centric interaction priors from human videos without requiring real-world robot demonstrations in the target task contexts. Human2Any represents manipulation through object-object interaction motion, capturing task-relevant scene changes while abstracting away embodiment-specific details. It composes learned interaction priors with robot-side feasibility reasoning and motion planning, allowing the same human-derived knowledge to adapt to different embodiments, scene geometries, and task contexts. We validate Human2Any across diverse manipulation settings, including real-world experiments on a Franka tabletop setup and an RBY-1 humanoid mobile robot, demonstrating robust interaction-centric manipulation without real-world robot training data.
selectionReason: 提出了一种从人类视频中学习物体交互先验并通过约束感知组合规划跨不同机器人形态部署的方法，在 Franka 和人形机器人 RBY-1 上实现了零样本迁移，不需要目标场景的机器人演示数据。

title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
oneLiner: 提出2.6B参数VLA模型ZR-0，通过96.8%帧覆盖率的具身思维链（ECoT）密集监督实现跨embodiment表示对齐，训练时强制System 2推理，推理时零成本跳过，LIBERO平均97.8%超越多数SOTA。
researchQuestion: 跨embodiment VLA迁移的核心挑战：不同机器人的低层状态和动作空间差异巨大（关节数、控制接口、传感器配置不同），现有方法仅在格式层面做零填充或维度归一化，未能解决语义对齐问题。但高层认知过程（场景感知、目标识别、任务规划、子任务分解）跨embodiment共享——如何利用这个共享认知层实现表示对齐？
contribution: ZR-0提出了一个优雅的跨embodiment迁移方案：用ECoT密集监督在训练时强制VLM学习共享的具身认知表示，通过交叉注意力掩码实现推理时完全无额外开销。这种"训练时注入、推理时隐式"的设计理念，相比运行时显式推理（如DeepThinkVLA）在效率上具有明显优势。96.8%帧覆盖率的ECoT标注规模也是目前已知最高。
abstract: Cross-embodiment transfer in vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging because low-level state and action spaces differ fundamentally across robot platforms. We observe that the high-level cognitive process underlying manipulation, including scene perception, object identification, task planning, and sub-task decomposition, is largely shared across embodiments. Based on this observation, we present ZR-0, a 2.6 billion parameter end-to-end VLA model that uses dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to align cross-embodiment representations within the vision-language model (VLM). ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (System 2) generates structured ECoT reasoning during training, while a Diffusion Transformer-based action expert (System 1) produces continuous action chunks via flow matching. The two components are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that restricts the action expert to input prompt features only, enabling ECoT generation to be entirely skipped at inference without any performance loss. ZR-0 is pre-trained on ProcCorpus-60M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 60 million frames (approximately 1,000 hours) from over 400K trajectories, with dense ECoT annotations covering 96.8% of all frames. We evaluate ZR-0 on three simulation benchmarks spanning single-arm (LIBERO), bimanual (RoboTwin 2.0), and humanoid (RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop) embodiments, as well as real-world experiments on the xArm platform, demonstrating strong performance across all settings. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0.
selectionReason: 提出Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT)密集监督实现跨embodiment VLA表示对齐。ECoT覆盖率96.8%，训练时强制VLM学习共享认知推理，推理时零成本跳过。LIBERO平均97.8%，三个仿真benchmark+真实xArm实验覆盖单臂/双臂/人形。ProcCorpus-60M含60M帧/1000小时/400K+轨迹。代码和模型权重已开源于GitHub。

title: Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints (SPARK)
oneLiner: 提出训练无关的神经符号操作系统SPARK，将测试时计算从规划转到感知：单一Gemini调用生成类型化行为树，SAM3自适应提示自一致性+无LLM恢复循环，Libero-Pro 43.7%超VLA（近0%）和CaP-Agent0（18.2%）。
researchQuestion: VLA在LIBERO上可达95%+，但面对LIBERO-Pro的位置-任务扰动时骤降至接近0%——VLA本质上是记住了特定布局的轨迹，目标位置偏移导致学到的绝对末端位置激活出分布。CaP-Agent0通过多轮代码生成恢复部分鲁棒性（18.2%），但每轮重新规划成本高昂。两者的共同问题：将测试时计算浪费在重构计划上，而真实瓶颈是感知层——物体位置变了，但任务结构没变。
contribution: SPARK对VLA社区的分布外鲁棒性问题提出了一个尖锐且有洞察力的诊断和解决方案：不是模型不够大或数据不够多，而是当前VLA本质上在记忆轨迹而非理解任务结构。同时，其"感知而非规划消耗计算预算"的设计选择值得深思——在LLM推理成本日益下降的今天，这是一个有远见的架构决策。生成的已验证轨迹还可作为VLA的训练数据。
abstract: We present Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints (SPARK), a training-free neurosymbolic manipulation system that reaches 43.7% on six Libero-Pro position-and-task cells, more than doubling CaP-Agent0 and existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines. Libero-Pro extends the traditional Libero benchmark by perturbing object positions and task descriptions, dropping VLA models from the top of simulated leaderboards to near-zero and revealing their inherent brittleness to unseen circumstances. CaP-Agent0, a multi-turn code-generation agent, recovers part of that loss by re-querying an LLM at every turn (18.2% on Libero-Pro), but its costly, restart-from-scratch solution proves bulky against minor policy failures. Both these approaches spend their test-time compute on reformulating the plan, when, really, perception is the layer that fails most under position and task changes. Thus, SPARK spends its computation there. A single Gemini call composes the plan as a typed behavior tree (BT) built from composable primitives, where each primitive already contains the low-level control (motion, grasping, depth geometry) a code-generation agent would otherwise regenerate on every trial. That leaves the rest of the test-time budget for perception: a second Gemini call proposes three alternative text prompts per object, SAM3 evaluates each prompt, and we keep the prompt→label pair that yields the most confident detection. Then, a recovery loop retries a failed primitive against freshly detected objects, with no new LLM call. Against CaP-Agent0's S2 evaluation protocol, these alternative prompts add +27.7 points on the spatial suite and +10.0 on the object suite; the recovery loop adds +5.0 overall. SPARK runs the same primitives on three robot families (UR10e, Franka FR3, bimanual Franka) across nine unique tasks at twenty trials each, averaging 68% overall across the physical setups. Because each of the detector, planner, and controller modules sit behind the typed plan, they swap independently without training. Furthermore, each primitive's checkable post-condition traces a failure to the corresponding module or a kinematic limit.
selectionReason: 提出训练无关的神经符号操作系统，将测试时计算从规划重新分配到感知层面。43.7% Libero-Pro（VLA接近0%），超CaP-Agent0 25.5个百分点。单一Gemini规划调用+自适应感知自一致性+无LLM调用的恢复循环。跨3种机器人家族验证，平均68%真实成功率。为VLA的分布外鲁棒性挑战提供了有洞察力的替代路径。

title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
titleZh: SimFoundry：面向策略学习与评估的模块化自动化场景生成系统
oneLiner: 从单段视频零样本重建可交互仿真场景，并通过自动生成物体、场景和任务的数字表亲，实现仿真策略评估与真实世界策略训练的闭环。
researchQuestion: 在真实世界中训练和评估机器人策略成本高昂且难以规模化。现有的 real-to-sim 系统要么侧重于场景重建，要么侧重于策略评估，很少有统一系统能同时完成从视频到仿真场景的自动化重建、在仿真中评估策略，并利用生成的仿真数据训练可迁移到真实世界的策略。此外，现有工作在任务复杂度（多为简单抓取放置）和场景多样性（单一数字孪生）方面存在局限。
contribution: SimFoundry 展示了 real-to-sim 技术从"重建一个场景"到"系统性生成仿真数据并驱动真实世界策略改进"的范式转换。其模块化设计允许随着基础模型进步而替换组件，三重数字表亲（物体、场景、任务）的概念为仿真数据的可控多样性提供了清晰的框架。该系统还证明了仿真评估可以有效替代真实世界基准测试，对于降低机器人策略开发成本具有重要意义。
abstract: Training and evaluating robot policies in the real world is costly and difficult to scale. We introduce SimFoundry, a modular and automated system for zero-shot real-to-sim scene construction from a video. SimFoundry generates sim-ready digital twins and supports object, scene, and task editing, enabling the automated generation of diverse digital cousins: affordance-preserving variations of reconstructed real-world scenes. Policies trained on SimFoundry data transfer zero-shot to challenging real tasks involving multi-step manipulation, articulated object interaction, and bimanual interaction, and its digital cousins (variations of the original scene, objects, and tasks) facilitate generalization to new real-world conditions. Across 7 manipulation tasks and 5 policy architectures, SimFoundry simulation evaluations strongly predict real-world performance, with mean Pearson correlation 0.911 and mean maximum ranking violation 0.018. When evaluating sim-trained policies zero-shot in the real world, policies trained with object, scene, and task cousins in simulation show average task success rate improvements of 17%, 21%, and 40%, respectively. Additional details at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/simfoundry/.
selectionReason: SimFoundry是NVIDIA GEAR实验室推出的全自动化real-to-sim场景构建与策略训练评估系统。其核心创新在于数字孪生(digital twin)与数字表亲(digital cousins)的统一框架：从单段视频自动重建sim-ready交互式场景，并通过对象、场景、任务三个维度的affordance-preserving变体生成无限训练数据。实验覆盖7个操作任务和5种策略架构(π0、π0.5、GR00T N1.6/N1.7、DreamZero)，跨DROID和YAM两种机器人平台，sim-to-real评估Pearson相关系数高达0.911，MMRV仅0.018。数字表亲分别带来17%(object)、21%(scene)、40%(task)的零样本成功率提升。该工作展示了仿真如何在大规模策略训练和可靠评估中替代昂贵且不可扩展的真实世界数据采集，是具身智能基础设施方向的重要进展。

title: WARP-RM: A Warp-Augmented Relative Progress Reward Model for Data Curation
titleZh: WARP-RM：用于数据筛选的时间扭曲增强相对进度奖励模型
oneLiner: WARP 从成功示范的变速与反转片段中自监督学习有符号相对进度，用于加权混合质量数据，使真实双臂折衣在劣质数据增加时仍保持 19/20 成功。
researchQuestion: 大规模遥操作数据包含停顿、回退和恢复，普通行为克隆会同等学习这些动作。绝对时间戳不是可靠进度标签：不同演示速度不同，也没有人工标注的子任务边界。论文研究能否只使用成功轨迹，通过相对片段顺序学习稠密进度信号，并据此筛选动作。
contribution: WARP 针对实际数据管线中很常见的问题：不是没有数据，而是数据好坏混在一起。无需阶段标注的自监督方案具有较强工程吸引力。
abstract: Scaling imitation learning requires large datasets, yet human teleoperation inevitably produces mixed-quality demonstrations containing hesitations and recoveries. Prior frame-level progress reward models supervise on absolute temporal progress proxies that suffer from label noise, or require costly human annotations to define subtask boundaries. We present WARP (Warp-Augmented Relative Progress), a novel fully self-supervised algorithm for learning dense, signed relative progress magnitudes dir
selectionReason: 提出WARP——全自监督的进度奖励模型，通过时间扭曲增强从成功演示中学习密集的相对进度信号。WARP-BC在混合质量数据上维持高性能（19/20 vs BC的2/20），吞吐量提升约18倍。在真实双臂机器人T恤折叠任务验证。解决模仿学习中数据质量过滤的关键实用问题。方法优雅且自监督，无需人工标注子任务边界。主要风险：仅在单任务（T恤折叠）上验证，泛化性待确认。

title: Advancing Omnimodal Embodied Agents from Isolated Skills to Everyday Physical Autonomy
titleZh: OmniAct：从孤立技能到日常物理自主的全模态具身智能体
oneLiner: OmniAct提出分层异步架构，通过多模态语义规划器统一网络-物理动作空间、事件边界驱动的自适应记忆压缩和异步视觉抢占引擎，在40项真实长时域任务上实现一致提升，token消耗近乎恒定。
researchQuestion: 构建在非结构化环境中持久运行的具身智能体需要统一协调异构工具（API、IoT等网络工具+操作、导航等物理工具），并在长时间操作中自主恢复物理故障。现有系统将这些问题割裂处理：VLM规划器缺乏统一的网络-物理动作空间，智能体框架上下文无限增长导致时序一致性退化，VLA策略开环执行无法检测自身失败。
contribution: 为持久具身自主提供了清晰的分层架构蓝图——明确解耦规划、记忆和验证三个子系统。事件边界驱动的记忆压缩是解决长时域上下文爆炸问题的优雅方案，异步抢占引擎填补了VLA策略开环执行的验证空白。
abstract: Building persistent embodied agents in unstructured environments demands unified orchestration of heterogeneous tools spanning both cyber (APIs, IoT) and physical (manipulation, navigation) domains, coupled with autonomous recovery from physical failures that inevitably arise over extended operation. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: VLM-based planners lack a unified cyber-physical action space, agent frameworks accumulate unbounded context that degrades temporal coherence, and
selectionReason: 构建了面向持久具身自主的OmniAct框架——将网络和物理行动空间统一的层次化异步架构。核心贡献：(1)统一行动空间的多模态语义规划器；(2)事件边界驱动的自适应层次记忆实现次线性上下文增长（关键创新）；(3)异步视觉抢占引擎在物理执行中闭合语义回路；(4)已开源代码。40个真实世界长时域任务上一致提升，中等开源模型达闭源水平，100k+token下内存近常数。将具身智能从孤立技能推进到日常物理自主。

title: VibeAct: Vibration to Actions for Contact-Rich Reactive Robot Dexterity
titleZh: VibeAct：从振动到动作的接触丰富反应式机器人灵巧操作
oneLiner: VibeAct通过共享的接触-滑动物理表征桥接真实振动触觉传感与仿真强化学习，在5项接触丰富任务中全面超越仅用本体感知和点云的基线，滑动幅度通道是关键驱动因素。
researchQuestion: 灵巧操作依赖快速、局部的接触事件，这些事件常因视觉遮挡而难以感知。压电麦克风提供了一种紧凑、高带宽的触觉传感方式，但振动声学信号难以在仿真中高保真地模拟，使得端到端的sim-to-real策略学习面临挑战。此前方法要么依赖真实世界的行为克隆（数据采集昂贵且难以扩展到多指灵巧手），要么在仿真中训练但无法利用振动触觉信号。
contribution: 压电麦克风作为低成本、紧凑的触觉传感器在机器人灵巧操作中具有巨大潜力。VibeAct提供了一条实用路线：无需仿真音频即可在仿真中训练利用振动触觉的策略。接触-滑动表征的解耦设计思路可推广到其他难以仿真的感知模态。
abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact events that are fast, local, and often visually occluded. Piezoelectric microphones offer a compact and high-bandwidth way to sense these interactions, but the resulting vibro-acoustic signals are difficult to simulate faithfully enough for end-to-end sim-to-real policy learning on dexterous robot hands. We propose VibeAct, a framework that bridges real vibrotactile sensing and simulation-based reinforcement learning through a shared physical representat
selectionReason: Strong vibrotactile sensing framework for dexterous manipulation. Novel contact+slip representation decouples sensing from control, enabling sim-to-real transfer without audio simulation. Evaluated across 5 diverse contact-rich tasks with real-robot deployment on LEAP Hand+xArm7. Slip magnitude channel identified as key driver. Fills a gap in tactile sensing for dexterous manipulation on the board.

title: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
titleZh: ABC：可扩展的开源行为克隆—开放数据、训练与评测
oneLiner: 提出完全开源的行为克隆技术栈ABC：核心为ABC-130K数据集（3500小时/130K episodes/195任务，最大开源双臂遥操作数据），配套开源硬件、训练基础设施和仿真co-training方案，系统性研究DiT与VLA架构选择。
researchQuestion: 行为克隆(Bahavior Cloning)是机器人操作的主流范式，但该领域长期面临三大障碍：(1) 开源操作数据集规模有限且多为单臂任务，缺乏大规模双臂灵巧操作数据；(2) DiT和VLA等不同架构选择缺乏在统一数据上的系统性对比；(3) 仿真训练与真实世界评估之间缺乏可靠的代理指标，导致真实世界实验成本高昂且效率低下。如何建立完全开放、可复现的行为克隆基础设施与评测体系？
contribution: ABC团队完整实践了"开放数据+开放训练+开放评测"的行为克隆研究范式。ABC-130K填补了双臂灵巧操作数据的关键空白。仿真-真实co-training方案为领域提供了一个降低真实世界实验成本的有效方案。系统性架构对比研究为DiT和VLA模型的设计选择提供了有真实世界验证基础的指导。完全开源的技术栈有望成为行为克隆社区的标准基础设施。
abstract: We introduce ABC, a fully open-source stack for manipulation with behavior cloning. At its core is ABC-130K: the largest open-source teleoperation dataset to date, featuring 3,500 hours of data spanning over 130K episodes across 195 diverse tasks. Furthermore, we open-source our accessible hardware setup, training infrastructure, and simulation pipeline. We also release 400 hours of sim-teleop data and provide a co-training recipe that produces correlated simulation and real-world evaluation, offering a reliable proxy for ablating model-design and training decisions before costly real-world evaluation. We explore various training recipes and compare common architectural choices for Diffusion Transformers (DiT) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, grounding our findings in real-world evaluations. The resulting policies successfully execute dexterous tasks such as box folding and extracting credit cards from wallets. By providing a reproducible toolkit, we aim to place researchers on an equal footing, establishing the necessary foundation to learn the ABCs of Behavior Cloning together as a community.
selectionReason: 目前最大开源双臂遥操作数据集ABC-130K（3500小时/130K episodes/195任务），完全开源硬件+训练+仿真全线。系统性的DiT和VLA架构对比研究，仿真-真实协同训练方案。开箱折叠、抽取信用卡等高难度灵巧任务，社区完整可复现工具包。

title: DynaMOMA: Instantaneous Prediction of Grasp Poses for Mobile Manipulation of Dynamic Objects
titleZh: DynaMOMA：动态物体移动操作的即时抓取姿态预测
oneLiner: DynaMOMA 用锚点扩散模型预测短时抓取轨迹，并以预期引导奖励训练全身移动操作策略，在仿真和真实运动目标上显著优于反应式基线。
researchQuestion: 移动机器人抓静态物体已经较成熟，但动态目标要求底盘、机械臂和相机共同追踪不断变化的未来接触点。只对当前帧反应会始终落后于目标；直接预测单个远期姿态又可能时间不连续。论文研究如何快速产生短时一致的抓取轨迹，并让全身控制器真正利用预测。
contribution: 这项工作把移动抓取从“追当前目标”改为“为未来接触提前占位”，并把视角管理纳入全身控制，对动态仓储和人机协作场景具有直接意义。
abstract: Mobile manipulation is a fundamental robotics task and has advanced rapidly in recent years, enabling robots to navigate, reach, and interact with objects in complex environments. However, mobile manipulation of dynamic objects remains highly challenging, as robots must coordinate the mobile base and arm while adapting to continuously evolving target poses. A key challenge lies in predicting temporally consistent short-horizon grasp trajectories from dynamic observations. In this work, we propos
selectionReason: 针对移动操作中动态物体抓取这一挑战性问题，提出DynaMOMA——锚点扩散模型预测时序一致抓取轨迹+全身RL控制。预测-控制耦合设计合理，预期引导奖励赋予策略预测性抓取视野。仿真结果验证有效。方法对动态移动操作有实用价值。在include下边界附近，主要因为仅仿真验证和无真实机器人实验。

title: One Body, Two Minds: Variable Autonomy Approach for a Co-embodied Robotic Hand
titleZh: 一个身体、两个心智：共具身机器人手的可变自主方法
oneLiner: 论文让人和机器人共享一只可穿戴机械手，并按搜索、抓取与工具使用阶段切换自主权；44 人研究中最佳模式达到 93.6% 成功率。
researchQuestion: 全自主辅助设备会削弱使用者控制感，完全手动又持续占用注意力。传统共享自主多在人和机器人各自拥有身体时混合命令。论文提出“共具身”：机械手直接成为用户身体的一部分，但拥有自己的感知和策略，并根据任务阶段改变谁主导。
contribution: 它把自主权设计从算法混合提升为具身交互问题：同一个身体可以在不同阶段由两套“心智”接管。对辅助机器人和可穿戴机器人而言，这是比单纯提高策略成功率更重要的设计维度。
abstract: Assistive robotic systems face a fundamental trade-off: fully autonomous systems lack user agency, while fully user-controlled systems demand continuous cognitive effort. Existing shared autonomy approaches blend human and robot commands but are mostly deployed in separate physical bodies. We introduce co-embodiment with variable autonomy, where human and robot share a single physical body and operate at different autonomy levels across task phases, from mutual autonomy during object search and
selectionReason: 提出人机'共具身+可变自主'新范式——区别于传统共享自主中的连续协商，人与机器人共享同一物理身体并按任务阶段切换自主级别。核心贡献：(1)共具身可穿戴机器人手设计；(2)从互自主（搜索/抓取）到人主导（操作）的自主级别切换；(3)头手势控制+释放手势否决权。44人用户研究统计充分，接受度高。为人机协作提供了新颖的具身交互视角。

title: Scaling Nonlinear Optimization: Many Problems One GPU
titleZh: 扩展非线性优化：在一张 GPU 上求解多个问题
oneLiner: jaxipm 将 IPOPT 风格的内点法改写为可在 JAX/GPU 上批处理的求解器，在四旋翼 NMPC 测试中把多问题吞吐量最高提升至 IPOPT 的 32.85 倍。
researchQuestion: 轨迹优化、逆运动学和接触规划通常会转化为非线性规划。IPOPT 等成熟求解器能严格处理约束，但以 CPU 单问题执行为主，难以嵌入 GPU 并行的机器人学习管线。困难不只是矩阵计算：不同优化实例会在迭代中触发不同的线搜索、可行性恢复和障碍参数分支，普通 SIMD 批处理会因分支不一致而空转。
contribution: 它不是新机器人策略，却可能直接改变最优轨迹生成、MPC 和模仿学习数据制作的规模。对 Embodied AI 看板而言，这类“让传统优化进入 GPU 批处理时代”的工具值得作为基础设施单独追踪。
abstract: Many robotics problems, including trajectory optimization, inverse kinematics, and contact-rich motion planning, reduce to nonlinear programs (NLPs). Mature NLP solvers such as IPOPT can solve these problems, offering hard constraint satisfaction, optimality guarantees, and favorable scaling with problem dimension. These solvers underpin gradient-based methods in robotics, yet remain CPU-bound and solve only one problem at a time, preventing their integration into GPU-batched learning pipelines.
selectionReason: Important infrastructure contribution: first GPU-batched NLP solver in JAX. 32.85x speedup over IPOPT enables integration into GPU-batched robotics learning pipelines. Open-source code at github.com/johnviljoen/jaxipm. While not directly an embodied policy paper, this is a critical enabler for gradient-based robotics methods at scale. Fills infrastructure gap on board.

title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
titleZh: Play2Perfect：灵巧操作中游戏预训练对精密装配的关键因素研究
oneLiner: Play2Perfect提出任务无关的"游戏"预训练框架，在多物体上学习抓取、手中重定向等操作先验，再微调至精密装配，实现33倍采样效率提升和0.5mm间隙的零样本sim-to-real装配。
researchQuestion: 多指灵巧手在精密装配中面临双重挑战：接触丰富的特性使模仿学习数据采集困难，稀疏奖励使直接强化学习探索不可行。此前工作依赖专用夹爪、工具附件和环境夹具来结构化问题。Play2Perfect提出一个核心假设：在学会完美装配之前，机器人必须先学会"玩耍"——即通过与多样物体的自由交互获取可复用的操作先验。
contribution: 精密装配是灵巧操作中最具挑战性的任务之一。Play2Perfect的"先玩后精"范式为多指灵巧手的精密操作提供了一条可扩展路径，系统性消融研究为预训练设计提供了明确指导。
abstract: Multi-fingered robots promise the speed and dexterity of human hands, yet challenging problems such as precise assembly have remained out of reach. These tasks are contact-rich, making data collection for imitation learning difficult, and sparse-reward, making direct exploration with reinforcement learning (RL) intractable. Consequently, prior work has made progress by structuring the problem with specialized grippers, tool attachments, and environment fixtures. In this work, we argue that befor
selectionReason: Exceptional paper on dexterous assembly. Play pretraining for precise manipulation is a compelling paradigm shift. 33x sample efficiency, 0.5mm clearance insertion, zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and systematic ablation of design choices make this a standout. Published June 24 by Stanford (Bohg, Liu labs). Fills a critical gap in dexterous assembly on the board, which currently has limited coverage of high-precision contact-rich tasks.

title: NoContactNoWorries: Estimating Contact through Vision and Proprioception for In-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
titleZh: NoContactNoWorries：用视觉与本体感知估计手内灵巧操作接触
oneLiner: 论文用 RGB-D、关节状态和运动意图预测二值指尖接触，以“伪触觉”驱动手内旋转，在仿真与真实硬件上减少对专用触觉传感器的依赖。
researchQuestion: 触觉对手内旋转很重要，但在所有指尖安装、标定和维护传感器成本高。人类也会结合视觉、姿态和自身动作推断是否接触。论文研究机器人能否学习同类的视觉—本体接触判断，并让下游策略把预测信号当作二值触觉使用。
contribution: 它提供了一条扩展触觉策略的折中路线：不复制完整触觉物理，只预测控制器真正需要的二值事件。对没有触觉硬件的现有灵巧手尤其有实用价值。
abstract: Perceiving physical contact is fundamental to dexterous manipulation. While robots often rely on dedicated hardware tactile sensors, humans exhibit a remarkable ability to infer contact by integrating visual information with an innate sense of their body's pose and movement. Inspired by this embodied perceptual skill, we investigate whether a robot can learn to infer contact from vision, an approach that also offers a scalable alternative to tactile hardware specifically for binary contact estim
organizations: International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad
selectionReason: 探索从视觉+本体感觉推断接触作为触觉替代方案的可扩展路径。核心贡献：(1)Transformer多模态框架融合RGB-D和本体感觉预测二元接触；(2)伪触觉信号支持下RL手中物体重定向；(3)跨物体泛化。为触觉感知的规模化提供新思路——不依赖昂贵触觉硬件。方法实用，在灵巧操作中降低硬件依赖。

title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
titleZh: HiL-ResRL：基于人在环残差强化学习的模型无关微调适配器
oneLiner: HiL-ResRL 冻结已有模仿/VLA 策略，只学习人在环纠正的残差动作，在 40–90 分钟真实训练后把三类精密任务成功率提高到 90% 以上。
researchQuestion: 行为克隆和生成式策略常在示范分布内表现良好，却会因累积误差在插入、竖直放置等瓶颈状态停滞。直接对大模型做在线 RL 成本高，也可能破坏已有能力；完全自主探索则有碰撞和过载风险。论文研究能否把任意基策略当作固定先验，只学习局部纠错层。
contribution: 它针对部署中常见的最后一公里：基础策略已经会做大部分动作，却卡在少量精密状态。冻结大模型并学习安全残差，比重新收集全量示范或端到端在线微调更轻量，具有明确工程价值。
abstract: Recent advancements in generative imitation learning have significantly propelled the field of robotic manipulation. However, the majority of existing models rely heavily on Behavior Cloning (BC), a paradigm that suffers from compounding errors and distributional shift. Consequently, the efficacy of these models in practical industrial deployments remains limited. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel, plug-and-play fine-tuning pipeline designed to facilitate the robust deployment of
selectionReason: Practical fine-tuning pipeline for VLA deployment. Model-agnostic approach is valuable for industrial adoption. 95% success after only 1.5 hours of real-world training is impressive. However, no code available and results are from a narrow set of industrial tasks.

title: Asymmetric physics enables efficient learning in quadrupedal robot swarms
titleZh: 非对称物理促进四足机器人集群的高效学习
oneLiner: 论文用高保真非可微仿真执行接触、用可微代理反传梯度的“非对称物理”，训练最多 512 个四足体的去中心化导航策略，并零样本部署到 6 台 Go2。
researchQuestion: 四足集群要同时处理视觉感知、机器人间密集互动、障碍规避和全身行走，纯采样强化学习在智能体数增大后效率很低；纯可微仿真又难以可靠表达碰撞与足地接触。论文关注如何兼顾真实动力学执行与一阶梯度训练，使大规模具身集群学会只依靠局部观测协调。
contribution: 具身集群往往被“高保真但慢”和“可微但不真实”夹住。这项工作展示了把两种物理模型分工使用的可行性，并把群体协同行为连接到真实腿式硬件，是多机器人方向较有信息增益的结果。
abstract: Animal collectives navigate cluttered environments through local coordination, yet robot swarms still struggle to reproduce this capability in the physical world. End-to-end learning offers a route to such coordination, but scaling it to embodied swarms remains difficult: standard sampling-based reinforcement learning becomes inefficient when visual perception, dense robot-robot interaction, and contact-rich locomotion must be learned together. Here we show that asymmetric physics enables effici
selectionReason: Impressive scaling of quadruped swarm learning via asymmetric physics. 512 agents in simulation, zero-shot transfer to 6 physical robots. Emergent swarm behaviors (predictive avoidance, yielding, wall following) are compelling. Fills multi-robot/swarm gap on the board. However, no code release limits reproducibility.

title: DexTeleop-0: Force-Aware Bimanual Dexterous Teleoperation with Ego-Centric Perception towards Shared Autonomy
titleZh: DexTeleop-0：面向共享自主的力感知双臂灵巧遥操作
oneLiner: DexTeleop-0 在人类动作映射之外加入实时触觉优化，用机器人自身的接触力修正关节指令，提高精密双臂遥操作的成功率与安全性。
researchQuestion: 人手与机器人灵巧手在关节数量、运动范围和接触几何上并不一致。直接追踪人手姿态虽然直观，却容易在装配、插入和物体转移中产生过大接触力、卡死或滑落。论文研究如何保留操作者的高层意图，同时让机器人根据自身触觉自主调整动作，从而提高高精度示范采集的效率。
contribution: 高质量示范不仅取决于人类动作捕捉，还取决于机器人能否安全、稳定地复现接触。DexTeleop-0 展示了一种实用分工：人负责意图，低层触觉闭环负责适应具体机器人，这对构建精密操作数据采集系统很有价值。
abstract: Fine-grained, bimanual dexterous manipulation remains a foundational challenge in robotics. Traditional teleoperation systems often fail in contact-rich tasks because embodiment gaps hinder accurate kinematic mapping, while tactile and force feedback remain absent. Consequently, data collection efficiency for high-precision tasks remains prohibitively low. To address these limitations, we propose a tactile-driven adaptation strategy designed to enable fine-grained manipulation on top of teleoper
selectionReason: Solid bimanual teleoperation system with tactile-driven adaptation. Addresses embodiment gap with real-time optimization. Both simulated and real-world evaluation. However, primarily a teleoperation system rather than autonomous policy learning. Project page available but no code.

title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
titleZh: dVLA-RL：在离散扩散去噪轨迹上进行 VLA 强化学习
oneLiner: dVLA-RL 不只对最终离散动作计算策略梯度，而是沿掩码去噪轨迹分配奖励，从而把 PPO 后训练扩展到离散扩散 VLA。
researchQuestion: 离散扩散 VLA 将视觉、语言和动作统一为 token，通过多步取消掩码并行生成动作。现有 VLA RL 多针对自回归或连续扩散/流模型；若只对最终动作奖励，离散扩散中间步骤没有清晰信用分配。论文研究如何利用每步边际概率，对完整去噪路径做强化学习。
contribution: 它填补了 VLA RL 的架构空白：如果离散扩散要成为通用动作解码器，就需要与其生成过程匹配的后训练目标，而不是直接复制连续策略方法。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have established a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding control into the semantic reasoning of VLMs. Prevailing architectures typically model actions continuously via diffusion or flow processes, or discretely through either autoregressive generation or parallel decoding. Recently, Discrete Diffusion VLAs (dVLAs) have emerged as a distinct alternative, unifying vision, language, and action into a single discrete token space via ma
selectionReason: 首次探索离散扩散VLA模型的RL后训练——解决离散扩散中间步骤奖励分配的关键挑战。技术创新：(1)在去噪轨迹上而非最终动作上计算RL奖励；(2)适配dVLAs边际概率特性的奖励设计。填补了VLA RL后训练的一个细分空白（之前工作主要在连续扩散VLA上）。实验证明可行性。

title: CoorDex: Coordinating Body and Hand Priors for Continuous Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
titleZh: CoorDex：面向连续灵巧人形移动操作的身体与手部先验协调
oneLiner: CoorDex将高维身体和灵巧手控制转化为协调的潜在残差控制，通过分离身体先验（运动/腕部定位）和手部先验（手指协调），使Unitree G1+WUJI手在行走中连续完成抓取、开门等操作。
researchQuestion: 人形运动操作通常被简化为"停-走"流程：走到物体旁、停下操作、再继续行走。现有系统多使用低自由度末端执行器或基于原语的简单操作。当人形机器人在行走中操作时，腕部位姿来自足部时序、躯干姿态和全身伸展，手部先验若还需解释6D腕部运动会消耗大量容量用于身体侧定位而非手指协调。核心挑战是分解并协调身体侧的腕部定位与手部侧的手指运动。
contribution: 首次系统解决行走中人形机器人高自由度灵巧操作的协调控制问题。"先验+残差"的双层架构设计将身体-手部协调分解为可训练的模块，为高维人形运动操作提供了结构化解决方案。
abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation is often simplified into a stop-and-go process: walking to an object, stopping to manipulate it, and then resuming locomotion. It also commonly relies on low degree-of-freedom (DoF) end effectors that behave like an open-close grasp primitive. We introduce CoorDex, a learning pipeline that converts high-dimensional body and dexterous hand control into coordinated latent residual control, enabling high-DoF dexterous loco-manipulation on the move. Starting from simulated
organizations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
selectionReason: Breakthrough in humanoid loco-manipulation: continuous dexterous manipulation while walking, moving beyond stop-and-go paradigm. Coordinated latent residual control elegantly handles the high-dimensional action space. Real robot demos on Unitree G1 with 20-DoF WUJI hand. Strong ablations showing baselines fail. Project page at skevinci.github.io/coordex/. Fills a major gap in continuous humanoid loco-manipulation.

title: LIBERO-Safety: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Physical and Semantic Safety in Vision-Language-Action Models
titleZh: LIBERO-Safety：面向视觉—语言—动作模型的物理与语义安全基准
oneLiner: LIBERO-Safety 通过参数化场景和关键姿态数据生成，构建包含 19,664 条示范的安全操作基准，系统比较十种 VLA/基础模型的物理与语义违规。
researchQuestion: VLA 的任务成功率提升很快，但“完成任务”并不等于“安全完成”：机器人可能碰撞禁区、施加危险动作，或违反语言中关于对象和顺序的约束。现有操控基准通常只统计成功，不容易控制风险因素，也难以用遥操作覆盖大量危险边界案例。论文希望把安全约束变成可程序化生成、可重复评测的独立维度。
contribution: 安全需要从单一成功率中拆出来。LIBERO-Safety 的价值在于提供可控风险变量和跨模型共同坐标，使社区能观察“能力增强是否牺牲安全”，也为后续安全微调与运行时过滤提供数据基础。
abstract: Despite the impressive manipulation capabilities of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, their operational safety under strict constraints remains largely unverified. To address this, we introduce a parametric safety benchmark to procedurally generate safety-critical scenarios with comprehensive stochasticity. To overcome the scalability bottlenecks of human teleoperation, we develop a novel keypose-driven data generation pipeline. Leveraging this infrastructure, we curate a large-scale dataset
organizations: Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University
selectionReason: Important safety benchmark for VLA models in manipulation. Large-scale (19,664 demos) with procedural generation. Systematic evaluation across 10 models with actionable failure-mode insights. Project page available (libero-safety.github.io) but no code. Fills critical safety evaluation gap on board.

title: Learning Dexterous Manipulation Using Contact Wrench Guidance From Human Demonstration
titleZh: 利用人类演示中的接触力旋量引导学习灵巧操作
oneLiner: 通过物体中心的接触力旋量空间引导，将人类演示的接触模式转移到机器人强化学习策略中，实现大规模、长程、双手灵巧操作。
researchQuestion: 灵巧机器人操作可以从丰富的人类演示数据中获益，但由于人类与机器人在形态学、运动学和手部几何形状上的差异，直接将人类手部运动转移到机器人策略面临巨大挑战。现有方法要么依赖脆弱的假设（如匹配 3D 接触位置），要么需要为每个任务和物体收集对齐的人机数据，难以规模化。CHORD 试图回答：机器人如何从人类演示中学习可迁移且可规模化的任务知识？
contribution: CHORD 的核心洞察——在力旋量空间而非接触位置空间进行人机对齐——为从人类演示学习灵巧操作提供了新的范式。力旋量空间天然与执行体无关，解决了不同形态手之间的迁移难题。该方法在 4,739 个任务上的规模化验证和真实机器人部署，表明这一范式具有较强的实用价值。此外，论文展示了从单目 RGB 视频端到端重建手物交互并落地到机器人策略的完整管线（Appendix C），为"看视频学操作"提供了可行的技术路线。
abstract: Dexterous robot manipulation can benefit from the abundance of human demonstrations, but transferring such demonstrations to robot policies remains challenging. We present Contact Wrench Guidance from Human Demonstration in Robotic Dexterous Manipulation (CHORD), a framework for long-horizon manipulation of rigid and articulated objects with reinforcement learning. The key idea is object-centric contact wrench space guidance: we represent human and robot motions by the forces and torques they can induce on the object, enabling similarity to be measured by the induced instantaneous motions. This guidance makes reinforcement learning more scalable for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. We further introduce a large-scale simulation benchmark with 4,739 bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks, constructed from motion-capture datasets and reconstructed in-house videos. Evaluated on 1,831 benchmark tasks, CHORD achieves an average success rate of 82.12%, demonstrating strong scalability. CHORD also generalizes to whole-body manipulation from hand-only and third-person demonstrations, achieving a 90.77% success rate, and the learned policies transfer to the real world in both open-loop and closed-loop settings. Videos and code are available at https://nvidia-isaac.github.io/video_to_data/chord/.
selectionReason: 提出接触力旋量空间引导（CWG）的新范式，将人类演示的接触模式转移到机器人策略中，并在大规模基准（4,739 任务）和真实机器人上验证了可扩展性与 sim-to-real 能力。

title: Scalable Multi-Task Data Generation via Reinforcement Learning for Language-Conditioned Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
titleZh: 面向语言条件双臂灵巧操作的可扩展多任务数据生成
oneLiner: RLDC 用任务专用强化学习教师在仿真中自动采集多模态轨迹，再蒸馏为语言条件的双臂扩散策略，以减少灵巧操作对人工遥操作数据的依赖。
researchQuestion: 双臂灵巧策略缺少规模大、动作可执行且覆盖多任务的数据。遥操作成本高，人类视频存在形态差异和动作缺失；基于参考轨迹的仿真增强又可能在旋转物体或改变场景后产生碰撞。强化学习能主动寻找可执行轨迹，但通常需要为每个任务重新设计奖励。论文研究能否用一套较通用的奖励与数据管线，生成可用于语言条件多任务策略的仿真数据。
contribution: 工作把合成数据问题从“变换已有示范”转为“让 RL 主动产生可执行示范”，并利用仿真状态监督视觉策略。即使当前规模有限，这种教师生成、学生蒸馏的结构对建设灵巧操作数据引擎具有参考意义。
abstract: A key bottleneck in training generalist policies for bimanual dexterous manipulation is the lack of large-scale, high-quality datasets. Synthetic data generation in simulation provides a scalable alternative to human video demonstrations by overcoming challenges such as morphology mismatch, missing physical interactions, and the generation of robot actions. However, existing approaches based on human teleoperation offer limited task diversity, as object-centric trajectory matching often neglects
selectionReason: Useful data generation pipeline for bimanual dexterous manipulation using RL. Addresses key scaling bottleneck. However, evaluation limited to 3 tasks, no real-robot results apparent, and no code or project page available. Solid concept but thin on evidence compared to other papers in batch.

title: EgoSteer: A Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
titleZh: EgoSteer：面向可操控灵巧操作的自我中心视频全栈系统
oneLiner: EgoSteer构建从自我中心人视频到灵巧VLA预训练的全栈系统，包含EgoSmith数据管线（9.6K小时、吞吐量9倍提升）、统一遥操作与人工纠错平台，以及世界模型增强的VLA，在40+任务上展示语言引导操控、故障恢复和泛化能力。
researchQuestion: 可操控性（Steerability）是通用机器人策略的标志性能力，但在灵巧手系统中几乎缺失——根本瓶颈是缺乏大规模、语言对齐且动作精确的演示数据。现有灵巧操作数据要么依赖昂贵的遥操作，要么来自与部署不对齐的自我中心人视频。
contribution: 全栈系统设计将数据管线、遥操作平台和VLA训练统一为完整闭环，9.6K小时的数据规模和9倍吞吐量提升代表了从自我中心视频到灵巧操作的大规模数据工程突破。
abstract: Steerability is a defining capability of generalist robot policies, yet remains largely absent in dexterous-hand systems for lack of large-scale, language-aligned, and action-accurate demonstration data. To address this bottleneck, we present a full-stack system that scales dexterous VLA pre-training from egocentric human videos and enables data-efficient real-robot post-training. It integrates EgoSmith, a data pipeline that curates in-the-wild egocentric videos into 9.6K hours of high-quality p
selectionReason: 全栈系统解决灵巧手VLA可操控性瓶颈——从野外自我中心视频规模化预训练到真实机器人部署的完整管线。核心贡献：(1)EgoSmith数据管线——9.6K小时高质量预训练数据，9倍吞吐量且精度优于SOTA；(2)统一机器人栈（遥操作+人在回路修正）；(3)世界模型增强VLA架构；(4)开源系统、数据和模型。40+任务、两种具身、75+%长时域成功率。将人类数据利用、灵巧操作和VLA三个方向有机整合。相较看板中其他VLA工作，EgoSteer的端到端数据-训练-部署管线完整性突出。

title: Wh0: Generative World Models as Scalable Sources of Egocentric Human Hand Manipulation Data
titleZh: Wh0：生成式世界模型作为自我中心人手操作数据的可扩展来源
oneLiner: Wh0使用生成式视频世界模型合成5万集自我中心人手交互视频WM-H，与少量真实机器人数据联合训练，将预训练VLA模型的零样本未见任务成功率从8.3%提升至38.9%（4.7倍），验证了场景/具身对齐和可扩展生成的关键作用。
researchQuestion: 灵巧操作的规模化泛化需要跨物体、场景和任务的数据，但现有数据源面临规模与对齐的权衡：遥操作数据对齐部署但昂贵，仿真可扩展但有sim-to-real差距，真实自我中心视频规模大但与机器人部署存在场景差距（日常环境vs机器人工作空间）和具身差距（人手vs机器人手）。
contribution: 将生成式世界模型定位为"数据引擎"而非"环境模拟器"是一个重要转向。Wh0证明了合成人手交互数据可以有效桥接VLA预训练与机器人部署之间的鸿沟，其计算驱动而非人力驱动的数据生成范式对规模化灵巧操作具有深远意义。
abstract: Scaling dexterous manipulation requires generalization across objects, scenes, and tasks, yet existing data sources face a trade-off between scale and scene/embodiment alignment: teleoperation data is well aligned with robot deployment but expensive to collect; simulation is scalable but limited by the sim-to-real gap; and real egocentric videos scale effectively but remain misaligned with robot deployment. We propose Wh0, a framework that uses generative video world models as scalable and contr
selectionReason: Highly innovative use of generative video world models as data sources for dexterous manipulation. 50k-episode WM-H dataset bridges the data scaling gap. 4.7x improvement in zero-shot success (8.3%→38.9%) on real G1 humanoid across 18 tasks. Open-source code promised on project page. Fills a creative gap at the intersection of generative models and robot learning.

title: Geometric Action Model for Robot Policy Learning
oneLiner: 将几何基础模型（GFM）直接复用为操作策略：在GFM中间层插入因果未来预测器，单骨架同时输出未来3D几何和动作，比基础模型规模基线快55×，相机扰动场景+9.7%p。
researchQuestion: VLA和WAM继承了大模型的语义或时序先验，但本质上在2D图像或2D隐空间上操作——深度、尺度、遮挡等3D线索留待动作解码器自行解耦。这导致在相机视角和机器人初始位姿变化时泛化能力下降。如何将预训练几何基础模型（GFM）的显式3D先验注入操作策略，使其不仅理解静态场景几何，还能建模动作条件下的场景演化？
contribution: GAM在VLA和WAM两条主流路径之外提出了第三种可能：用几何基础模型替代语言/视频模型作为策略骨架。这一选择有深刻动机——操作任务本质上是3D物理交互，显式几何先验比语义或时序先验更接近问题的本质结构。55×加速和相机扰动下的鲁棒性提升为实际部署提供了直接价值。
abstract: Generalist robot policies must follow user instructions while reasoning about how objects, cameras, and robot actions interact in the 3D physical world. Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) and video world-action models (WAMs) inherit strong semantic or temporal priors from large-scale foundation models, but they still operate primarily on 2D image frames or 2D-derived latent spaces, leaving implicit the 3D geometry required for contact-rich manipulation. We propose the Geometric Action Model (GAM), a language-conditioned manipulation policy that directly repurposes a pretrained geometric foundation model (GFM) as a shared substrate for perception, temporal prediction, and action decoding. GAM splits the GFM at an intermediate layer: the shallow layers serve as an observation encoder, and a causal future predictor inserted at the split layer forecasts future latent tokens conditioned on language, proprioception, and action history. The predicted future tokens are then routed through the remaining GFM blocks for feature propagation and decoding, allowing a single backbone to produce both future geometry and actions. This design equips the GFM with language-conditioned temporal world modeling through minimal architectural modification while preserving its rich geometric priors. Across a broad suite of simulation and real-robot manipulation benchmarks, GAM is more accurate, more robust, faster, and lighter than current foundation-model-scale baselines.
selectionReason: 将几何基础模型（GFM）直接复用为操作策略的共享主干，通过中间层插入因果未来预测器将GFM改造为语言条件下的时序世界模型。在相机位姿扰动场景+9.7%p的改进直接证明了显式3D几何先验的价值。比当前基础模型规模基线快55×，同更少参数。为融合几何理解和机器人操控提供了优雅的架构设计。

title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
oneLiner: 提出触觉反应性灵巧操作框架T-Rex：100小时触觉同步数据集（207物体×22运动原语），可变速率MoT架构分离低频规划与高频触觉精调，12项接触密集任务平均超最强基线30%。
researchQuestion: 人类灵巧性依赖触觉信号的高速闭环反应。现有VLA模型要么忽略触觉模态，要么仅使用静态触觉编码器，原因包括：触觉预训练数据稀缺、VLA架构的频率不匹配（VLM低频推理vs. 触觉高频响应）、缺乏标准化评测基准。如何在不牺牲现有VLA视觉语言能力的前提下，有效整合高频触觉信号实现触觉反应性灵巧操作？
contribution: T-Rex是触觉反应性灵巧操作方向的重要进展。其核心洞察——触觉能力可通过专门的中训练阶段高效注入，无需在昂贵的大规模预训练中同步采集触觉数据——为大模型+灵巧操作的结合提供了经济可行的路径。100小时触觉同步数据集填补了该领域的关键数据空白。异步MoT的频率分离架构为多模态机器人基础模型的设计提供了参考范式。
abstract: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based VLAs for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, in part due to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mix-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control, deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.
selectionReason: 推动触觉反应性灵巧操作前沿：100小时触觉同步数据集（200+日常物体、22种运动原语），异步MoT架构融合低频视觉运动规划与高频触觉精调，12项接触密集型灵巧操作任务平均超最强基线30%。提出人类自视角预训练→触觉对齐中训练→目标域快速适配的三阶段范式。数据集计划MIT许可证开源。

title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
titleZh: 在视觉—语言—动作模型中解耦声明性与程序性知识
oneLiner: w²VLA 将“对象是什么、在哪里”与“技能如何执行”分开调制机器人状态序列，使从特定物体示范学到的基础技能能零样本迁移到外观不相似的新物体。
researchQuestion: 主流 VLA 把图像、语言、状态和动作 token 一起送入大型 Transformer，容易把对象语义与动作过程绑定。例如“拿香蕉”的示范可能只学会香蕉外观，而没有抽象出“拿”的程序。论文认为这种声明性知识与程序性知识纠缠，是技能迁移需要不断收集对象专用示范的根本原因。
contribution: 论文的价值主要是架构观点：VLA 泛化不只是模型和数据规模问题，也取决于是否给知识组合提供正确归纳偏置。即使当前任务简单，这一解耦思路值得后续模型检验。
abstract: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vi
selectionReason: 深刻洞察当前VLA模型泛化瓶颈——声明性知识与程序性知识的纠缠——并提出w2VLA通过重构信息流实现解耦。核心贡献：(1)识别VLA中知识纠缠的理论问题；(2)模块化设计——用视觉/空间/技能信息可组合调制而非全token送入大Transformer；(3)展示零样本技能迁移到不相似物体的能力。理论洞见深刻，设计思路清晰，对VLA架构设计有启发意义。

title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
titleZh: ENPIRE：真实世界中智能体驱动的机器人策略自我改进
oneLiner: 将编程智能体引入真实机器人策略自主改进：通过四模块闭环框架（环境搭建/策略改进/部署/进化），前沿编程智能体可自主训练策略在针盒整理、扎带紧固、GPU插拔等灵巧操作任务上达到99%成功率，多智能体+机器人集群显著加速学习。
researchQuestion: 真实世界灵巧操作严重依赖人类监督和算法工程，成为通向通用物理智能的中心瓶颈。编程智能体在数字环境中已展示自动化算法搜索的能力，但缺少在物理世界中可重复的策略改进反馈循环。核心问题：如何构建一个使编程智能体能在真实世界自主执行"重置场景→执行策略→验证结果→改进迭代"闭环的系统？
contribution: 这是首个将"自主研究"(autoresearch)范式应用于真实机器人策略学习的系统。其核心洞察——物理世界中的可重复反馈循环——为机器人自主研究提供了缺失的抽象层。多智能体协作和跨任务经验迁移的验证，展示了编程智能体在物理世界中规模化自主改进的可行路径。
abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating in parallel, and an Evolution module (E) in which coding agents analyze logs, consult literature, improve training infrastructure and algorithm code to address failure modes. This closed-loop system transforms real-world manipulation learning into a controllable optimization procedure, minimizing human effort while allowing fair ablations across training recipe and agent variants. Powered by ENPIRE, frontier coding agents can autonomously train a policy to achieve a 99% success rate on challenging, dexterous manipulation tasks, such as organizing a pin box, fastening a zip tie, and tool use, a process that further accelerates when we dispatch an agent team on a robot fleet.
selectionReason: 创新性地将编程智能体应用于真实机器人策略自主改进。提出ENPIRE四模块框架（环境/策略改进/部署/进化），实现从环境搭建、自动验证、自主复位的物理闭环自改进。前沿编程智能体可自主训练策略在针盒整理、扎带紧固等灵巧操作任务上达到99%成功率。多智能体+机器人集群加速策略搜索，展示了物理自主研究(autoresearch)的可行路径。

title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
titleZh: Vesta：通用具身推理模型
oneLiner: 提出统一具身通才模型Vesta：整合定位、导航、具身推理与记忆规划于一体的单模型，在多个基准上平均超越SOTA专家模型超20%、超越各维度最优基线集成超10%，真实机器人记忆推理任务成功提升超35%。
researchQuestion: 机器人在开放世界环境中需要无缝整合定位、空间推理、导航和长周期规划等多种能力。当前方案严重依赖多模型集成：定位模型、导航模型、规划模型各自独立部署，导致计算开销大且容易级联错误。能否用一个通才模型替代专家模型组合？
contribution: Vesta以简洁的方法论——精心数据混合+简单记忆机制——实现了与复杂专家系统相当甚至超越的性能。其核心启示在于：在具身通才模型中，空间定位能力的数据占比主导了模型的整体表现。简单的记忆机制（固定采样+文本日志）就足以支撑长周期推理，暗示当前任务不需要过于复杂的记忆架构。Vesta为"通才vs专家"的路线之争提供了实证支持。
abstract: Robots operating in open-world environments must seamlessly integrate localization, spatial reasoning, navigation, and long-horizon planning. While specialist models excel at individual tasks, deploying a multi-model stack is computationally expensive and prone to cascading errors. We present Vesta, a unified embodied generalist that consolidates these capabilities into a single foundation model. Our approach combines a diverse and massive curated corpus designed to induce spatial grounding and a simple multimodal memory harness that enables reasoning over extended time horizons. Across diverse benchmarks, Vesta on average beats individual SOTA baselines by >20% and beats an ensemble of per-category-best baselines by >10% – thus demonstrating that a generalist model can match or exceed specialists. On real-world robotic tasks requiring memory and reasoning, Vesta improves task success by >35%. Our work thus demonstrates that a single generalist is a feasible, scalable, and arguably preferable alternative to combining specialists.
selectionReason: 首个统一定位、导航、具身推理与记忆规划的单一体模型。基于Qwen3-VL-8B微调，在多个基准上平均超越SOTA专家模型>20%，超越各类别最优模型集成>10%。真实机器人记忆推理任务成功提升38.3%。证明了通才模型可匹敌甚至超越专家模型的可行性。

title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation
oneLiner: 提出训练无关的即插即用物理校正框架PhysVLA，以<1ms推理开销对任意冻结VLA进行选择性物理约束注入，跨4种VLA骨干成功率最高+17%、稳定性最高+19%，真实Agilex Piper臂验证+50%。
researchQuestion: VLA模型纯从行为演示数据拟合，不显式编码刚体动力学或接触约束。chunked inference（如OpenVLA-OFT 92%）虽比单步（OpenVLA 36%）大幅改善，但仍缺乏全局任务级物理一致性——多阶段接触密集操作中的物理不可行动作导致残余失败。如何在保留冻结VLA权重的条件下，以最小开销注入物理约束？
contribution: PhysVLA提出了一个实用性极强的范式：物理感知作为可组合的运行时模块，而非训练约束或控制器重设计。这种设计使任何已有VLA模型无需任何修改即可获得物理一致性改进，对工业部署场景（已有大量冻结VLA模型）具有直接应用价值。选择性校正（仅在需要时激活）而非均匀约束的设计理念也值得借鉴。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at mapping visual inputs and natural language instructions directly to robotic control policies. However, because they are trained primarily to fit behavioural demonstration data, they do not explicitly enforce fundamental physical principles such as rigid-body dynamics or contact constraints. This exposes a critical physics gap: standard temporal smoothing applied on top of single-step or chunked VLAs trades trajectory quality for added failures that short-term memory cannot resolve. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysVLA (Physics-VLA), a plug-and-play, inference-time framework designed to wrap any frozen VLA backbone without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, with less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. PhysVLA intercepts the predicted control action, captures only the simulator or system state, and applies a dual-layered correction: (i) a phase-aware finite-state machine that structures discrete task segments (approach, grasp, transport, and place), and (ii) a selective Euler-Lagrange gate that activates only when a dynamics oracle detects kinodynamic inconsistency. By enforcing physical constraints conditionally rather than uniformly, PhysVLA preserves the expressive multimodal reasoning of the underlying VLA while correcting physically implausible actions. Evaluated across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on LIBERO-Spatial with a 7-DoF Franka Panda, the same untuned framework delivers absolute success rate increase of up to 17% and absolute stability increase of up to 19% with no per-task regressions, improves trajectory efficiency by up to 15% across all four backbones, and shows up to a 10× improvement in trajectory jerk robustness on a Robosuite Lift cross-simulator sweep. We further validate the framework on a real Agilex Piper arm with a pick-and-place task, confirming that PhysVLA transfers to physical hardware without retraining, with success-rate improvements of up to 50%, establishing physical awareness as a composable, backbone-agnostic runtime module.
selectionReason: 训练无关、即插即用的推理时物理校正框架，<1ms开销，跨4种VLA骨干（OpenVLA/OpenVLA-OFT/Force-VLA/Generalist-VLA）一致提升。双分支校正（阶段感知FSM+选择性Euler-Lagrange门）在有物理不一致时才触发，避免过度约束。真实Agilex Piper臂验证，sim2real成功率+50%。为物理感知作为可组合运行模块提供了实用范式。

title: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
titleZh: HALOMI：从人类示范学习带主动感知的人形移动操作
oneLiner: HALOMI 将第一视角人类头手轨迹转为人形机器人全身移动操作策略，通过流形约束控制、视角对齐和轨迹适配，在真实 Unitree G1 三项任务上平均达到约 85% 成功率。
researchQuestion: 人类示范天然包含走动、转头与双手配合，但人类和人形机器人在视点、关节范围及全身动力学上存在差异。直接让机器人追踪世界坐标中的头手目标，遇到分布外姿态时容易失稳；只重定向手部又会丢失主动观察目标的行为。论文研究如何把可规模采集的第一视角人类数据转化为稳定的全身手眼协调。
contribution: HALOMI 的重点不是单独提高操作精度，而是把“看哪里、走到哪里、手怎么动”作为同一示范学习问题。它展示了第一视角人类数据对人形机器人全身技能的潜力，也清楚暴露了相对布局泛化仍是短板。
abstract: Human demonstrations, which can be collected at scale and naturally capture active hand-eye coordination, are a promising data source for learning humanoid loco-manipulation. However, directly transferring human demonstrations to humanoids requires a precise world-frame tracking controller, which is often brittle under Out-of-Distribution(OOD) targets, while human-to-humanoid gaps persist in both egocentric observation and action execution. To address these challenges, we present HALOMI, a scala
selectionReason: Solid humanoid loco-manipulation framework extending UMI to egocentric sensing. Manifold-constrained controller is novel. 85% success across 3 tasks on real Unitree G1. Dynamic behaviors (tossing, deep-squat grasping) are impressive. Project page available but no code.

title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
titleZh: 用物体中心残差强化学习零样本增强真实 VLA
oneLiner: 论文以物体位姿作为仿真—真实共享观察，并在仿真中重放真实示范对齐基础 VLA，使小型残差策略把五项真实 Franka 任务成功率从 42% 提升到 76%。
researchQuestion: 模仿学习 VLA 在精密接触中会累积误差。残差 RL 可冻结 VLA、只学纠错，但仿真训练面临两难：特权状态策略需要有损蒸馏，图像策略又受视觉域差。即使观察一致，仿真和真实基础 VLA 的失败分布也可能不同，残差会修正错误的问题。
contribution: 工作把残差 RL 的关键从“如何学修正”推进到“如何保证仿真里修正的失败与现实相同”。对象级接口与失败分布对齐是可复用的系统洞察。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generalize across diverse manipulation tasks, but their imitation-learning-based policies remain brittle in precise physical interactions due to compounding execution errors; Can a reinforcement learning policy trained purely in simulation improve the robustness of real-world VLAs zero-shot? Residual RL, which learns a corrective policy on top of a frozen VLA, offers a natural framework, but existing approaches face a fundamental sim-to-real dilemma: privi
selectionReason: 巧妙解决residual RL的sim-to-real迁移困境。核心创新：(1)用物体位姿作为紧凑观测空间，在仿真和现实中天然一致，无需域适应；(2)sim-replay对齐策略：在仿真中重放真实遥操作演示训练sim-VLA副本，消除VLA本身的sim-real策略差异；(3)位姿噪声注入+dropout实现鲁棒的零样本迁移。42%→76%提升，并可自我改进(self-improvement)。相较于PhysVLA(推理时修正)和一般的VLA微调方法，本工作从residual RL角度提供了互补的方案。来自Microsoft Research和KAIST合作。主要风险：依赖物体位姿估计精度，遮挡场景下可能退化；代码未明确开源。

title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
titleZh: WireCraft：工业柔性线状物体操作仿真基准
oneLiner: WireCraft 为线缆插接、布线和入槽提供统一仿真任务、难度配置与评测接口，并揭示特权状态策略和视觉策略之间仍存在明显差距。
researchQuestion: 电线和线缆没有刚体的单一六自由度姿态，会随夹爪、固定件和工作台接触持续变形。现有柔性物体研究往往绑定特定硬件或单项任务，不同 RL、模仿学习和 VLA 结果难以公平比较。WireCraft 希望提供面向工业装配的共同环境，覆盖从抓取、对准到持续形变控制的完整挑战。
contribution: 柔性线缆是工业机器人中重要但数据稀缺的类别。WireCraft 的价值不在新策略，而在把任务、难度和数据来源放到统一坐标中，并显示视觉策略距离可靠插接还有多远。
abstract: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), such as wires and cables, are central to industrial assembly. Unlike rigid objects, whose state is captured by a 6-DoF pose, DLOs have an infinite-dimensional configuration space and deform continuously under contact with grippers, fixtures, and the workspace, making them a demanding benchmark for general dexterous manipulation. Despite their importance, policy development and comparison remain difficult: existing benchmarks are often tied to specific hardware s
selectionReason: Important benchmark for a neglected problem: industrial DLO manipulation. Well-designed with configurable difficulty, two physics models, and shared interfaces. Clear gap demonstrated between privileged state and vision-based policies. Code promised upon acceptance. Fills DLO/deformable manipulation gap on board.

title: PAIWorld: A 3D-Consistent World Foundation Model for Robotic Manipulation
titleZh: PAIWorld：面向机器人操作的三维一致世界基础模型
oneLiner: PAIWorld 以跨视角通信、几何旋转位置编码和三维表征对齐改善机器人多相机视频生成，在 250 万视频片段上训练 14B 世界模型。
researchQuestion: 机器人策略常同时使用头部、外部和腕部相机，但多数视频世界模型按单视角设计；简单拼接多视角 token 容易产生物体漂移、深度不一致和纹理错位。对于基于想象的规划或策略后训练，这些几何错误会让不同相机中的未来状态互相矛盾。论文研究如何在大规模视频模型中显式加入跨视角三维约束。
contribution: 相比继续放大单视角视频模型，PAIWorld 把机器人天然存在的多相机几何作为结构先验。若资产开放，它可能成为基于世界模型生成训练数据和多视角规划的重要基础；目前更应把它视为高成本、待复现的方向性结果。
abstract: World foundation models (WFMs) are powerful simulators, yet they predominantly operate in a single-view setting and lack the multi-view 3D consistency required for robotic manipulation. While robotic systems rely on multiple cameras (egocentric, eye-to-hand, and wrist-mounted) for policy learning, current multi-view world models simply concatenate view tokens without explicit geometric reasoning. This causes cross-view object drift, depth inconsistency, and texture misalignment. We trace these f
selectionReason: State-of-the-art multi-view world foundation model for manipulation. Leaderboard-topping results on WorldArena and AgiBot-Challenge. 14B parameters, 2.5M video clips. Geometric innovations (Geo-RoPE, 3D-REPA) are well-motivated. However, no code or model weights available, limiting reproducibility. Important infrastructure for model-based planning.

title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
titleZh: PRISM：扩展视觉运动策略的短期记忆以应对长程任务
oneLiner: 通过门控注意力过滤历史噪声+层级架构压缩局部信息整合长程依赖，使视觉运动策略的记忆扩展至两分钟；提出ReMemBench四类记忆基准，超越GR00T-N1-3B等VLA基线11-15%，且未使用大规模预训练。
researchQuestion: 许多机器人任务需要短期记忆——取回已不可见的物体、延迟关闭电器等。但大多数基于模仿学习的视觉运动策略仅依赖即时感知输入，不使用历史经验。现有Transformer方法面临三大挑战：(1) 注意力随上下文线性增长导致计算开销大；(2) 视觉输入产生高token成本；(3) 不相关历史tokens降低性能。如何高效地在视觉运动策略中扩展短期记忆？
contribution: 短期记忆是视觉运动策略处理长程任务的瓶颈能力，但目前缺乏系统性的架构设计和标准化评测。PRISM的门控注意力+层级压缩架构为Transformer策略的高效记忆扩展提供了简洁有效的方案，ReMemBench填补了记忆基准的空白。未使用大规模预训练就超越VLA基线的结果令人印象深刻。
abstract: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%-12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%-15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned VLA baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining.
selectionReason: 提出PRISM架构和ReMemBench基准，系统性地解决了视觉运动策略中短期记忆的扩展问题。门控注意力过滤不相关历史信息，层级架构先压缩局部信息再整合长程依赖，使策略记忆可扩展至两分钟。在ReMemBench四个记忆类别（空间/物体集/物体关联/前瞻）的8个任务上超越基线5-12%，在RoboCasa和LIBERO上超越GR00T-N1-3B和OpenVLA达11-15%，且未使用大规模预训练。

title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
titleZh: V2P-Manip：从单目人类视频学习灵巧操作
oneLiner: V2P-Manip 从普通单目视频恢复手—物体三维轨迹，再用几何、接触和强化学习修正将其转化为多种机器人手可执行的操作策略。
researchQuestion: 互联网和日常拍摄的人类视频远多于机器人遥操作数据，但视频没有机器人动作，只提供受相机运动、遮挡和深度歧义影响的二维观察。直接重定向得到的轨迹常出现穿模、接触不稳和不可执行姿态。论文试图建立从单目视频、物体资产、三维轨迹恢复到机器人策略训练的一体化流程。
contribution: 论文关注的是人类视频真正进入机器人训练前最难的一层：把“看起来合理”变成“物理上能执行”。它没有消除真实部署鸿沟，但清晰组合了视觉恢复、接触优化与残差 RL，可作为视频数据转机器人策略的工程参考。
abstract: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated p
selectionReason: Interesting video-to-policy pipeline extracting dexterous manipulation from human videos. Good alternative data source to teleoperation. However, evaluation is only on synthetic/simulation tasks — no real-robot deployment. No code or project page available.

title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
titleZh: ACE-Ego-0：统一自我中心人类与机器人数据的 VLA 预训练
oneLiner: ACE-Ego-0提出统一动作表征和可靠性感知训练目标，将1.48K小时伪动作标注的自我中心人视频与4.53K小时机器人数据联合预训练，在RoboCasa GR1 TableTop达72.8%，RoboTwin2.0达91.12%（Easy）/90.62%（Hard），并展示真实双臂操作迁移。
researchQuestion: VLA模型受益于大规模多样化数据，但机器人轨迹采集昂贵且劳动密集。自我中心人视频提供互补的真实世界监督，但联合训练面临动作空间、具身结构、时序动态和监督质量四个维度的分歧。现有跨具身方法通过共享动作空间或具身特定tokenizer处理表征异构性，但仍受限于机器人数据采集的可扩展性。
contribution: ACE-Ego-0在VLA数据工程上提出了系统性方案——从统一动作空间到可靠性感知训练到五阶段管线，解决了异构数据联合训练的四个核心分歧。6.0K+小时的数据规模和人-机联合训练范式对VLA社区具有重要参考价值。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretrain
organizations: Chinese University of Hong Kong MMLab
selectionReason: 系统性解决人类自我中心视频与机器人数据联合训练四大挑战的VLA预训练框架。核心贡献：(1)首次明确识别并逐一解决动作空间分歧、形态结构分歧、时序动态分歧和监督质量分歧四个障碍；(2)可扩展的ego video-to-action管线将1.48K小时人类视频转为伪动作轨迹；(3)可靠性感知训练目标(human auxiliary loss)通过加权策略自动聚焦可靠信号，避免噪声标签损害训练；(4)在RoboCasa GR1 TableTop和RoboTwin 2.0上达到SOTA，并验证了真实世界双臂迁移。6K+小时总训练数据。相较于看板中已有的纯机器人数据VLA，ACE-Ego-0从异构数据融合角度提供了重要的规模化路径。代码已公开。主要风险：依赖伪动作标注管线的质量，人类视频选择偏向性可能引入偏差。

title: SAPS: Shared Autonomy for Policy Steering by Blending Teleoperation with a Pretrained VLA
titleZh: SAPS：混合遥操作与预训练 VLA 的共享自主策略引导
oneLiner: SAPS 在动作层直接混合人类遥操作与 VLA 输出，并用余弦相似度动态分配控制权，无需重训练即可提高分布外任务成功率。
researchQuestion: VLA 在空间或语义分布外条件下会突然失败，完全遥操作则要求操作者持续精确控制。已有 steering 方法常需辅助模型、采样器修改或再次训练。论文研究是否可以只比较人和策略当前动作方向，用一个模型无关仲裁器让人类只在必要时纠偏。
contribution: SAPS 是很实用的部署层方案：不等待重新训练模型，就能用少量人类纠正覆盖 VLA 的长尾失败，也提供了收集失败恢复数据的自然入口。
abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive generalist capabilities in robot manipulation, yet these policies can be brittle under out-of-distribution spatial and semantic perturbations. While human teleoperation offers reliable recovery, it can demand high cognitive load and precise manual control, and existing policy steering methods often require auxiliary models or sampler modifications. In this work, we introduce Shared Autonomy for Policy Steerin
selectionReason: 实用且优雅的免训练共享自主框架。核心贡献：(1)动作级别混合(VLA action + human teleop action)，无需任何模型修改或重训练；(2)创新的动态Cosine-similarity仲裁策略，利用人类和策略动作的几何一致性自动调节混合权重；(3)模型无关——验证了3种VLA+Diffusion Policy；(4)在LIBERO-PRO(OOD)和真实机器人上成功率最高提升82%，同时减少人工干预并加快任务完成。相较于看板中已有的训练时增强方法，SAPS从人机共享自主的角度提供了完全正交且立即可用的解决方案。来自CMU。主要风险：依赖人类操作员在场，不适用于完全自主场景；Cosine-similarity仲裁在策略和人类动作高度不一致时可能产生抖动。

title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects
titleZh: DragMesh-2：面向关节物体的物理合理灵巧手交互
oneLiner: DragMesh-2 从目标部件运动反推持续手—把手接触，并用物理信息接触感知训练提升灵巧手操作关节物体时的稳定性。
researchQuestion: 打开抽屉、柜门等任务不能直接驱动目标部件，其运动必须由手与把手的持续接触产生。只生成物体轨迹会忽略手的可达性、摩擦和受力；普通位置策略在阻尼变化后又容易滑脱。论文研究如何把对象中心的关节运动转化为多指手可执行、物理上自洽的交互。
contribution: 这项工作把关节物体生成从“目标部件动起来”推进到“手如何持续施力让它动起来”，并诚实量化了接触负载变化造成的崩溃，对灵巧操作和仿真数据生成都具有参考价值。
abstract: Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexter
selectionReason: Solid work on a challenging problem: dexterous interaction with articulated objects. PICA is clever — injects physical signals without tactile hardware. Code available at github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DragMesh-2. No real-robot experiments, but the simulation evaluation on contact-load robustness is thorough.

title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback
titleZh: UME：用实时扭矩反馈学习柔顺全身策略的通用操作外骨骼
oneLiner: UME 是带透明扭矩反馈的上肢外骨骼，可跨 OpenArm、Franka 和 X-ARM 重定向，并采集视觉、全臂姿态与关节扭矩以训练柔顺操作策略。
researchQuestion: 多数遥操作系统记录视觉和位置，却不能让操作者感觉机器人接触力，也缺少训练主动柔顺策略所需的扭矩数据。不同机械臂还通常需要各自的 leader 设备。论文研究能否用便携外骨骼同时实现跨机器人动作重定向、真实触觉反馈和移动操作采集。
contribution: UME 补足了机器人数据常缺失的“力感”：操作者不只示范轨迹，也示范何时顺应接触。它与纯视觉采集接口形成互补。
abstract: For robots to work safely in household environments, they need to be compliant and react to torque and force feedback during contact. However, the majority of existing data collection pipelines still lack the ability to capture force and torque data for learning active compliant policies. In this paper, we present Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), an upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torque signals for
selectionReason: 首个集成实时扭矩反馈的上肢外骨骼遥操作系统。核心贡献：(1)透明扭矩反馈使操作员可凭触觉感知接触力/力矩，实现蒙眼操作和柔顺策略学习；(2)通用重定向算法支持OpenArm(7DoF)、Franka(7DoF)、X-ARM(6DoF)三种机器人无缝切换；(3)嵌入式IMU支持移动操作遥操作；(4)验证了力介导盒子翻转、视觉遮挡盒子推动等独特能力。相较于看板中已有的数据采集接口(UMI, RealDexUMI)，UME从力/扭矩反馈角度提供了独特维度，使学习的策略天然具有柔顺性。Ant Group + Stanford合作。主要风险：商业公司(Ant Group)参与，硬件可获取性不确定；扭矩反馈仅在特定末端执行器上验证。

title: Robust Fall Recovery for Armless Bipedal-Wheeled Robots Via Force-Guided Learning
titleZh: 通过力引导学习实现无臂双足轮式机器人的鲁棒跌倒恢复
oneLiner: FTSR 用力引导教师、分阶段奖励和学生蒸馏，让没有手臂支撑的双足轮式机器人仅靠双腿从多种倒地姿态恢复，并在真实户外地形验证。
researchQuestion: 无臂双足轮式机器人跌倒后既不能像人形机器人用手撑地，也没有四足机器人的多支撑点，只能依靠两条腿产生大幅度接触力。单一站立奖励容易让策略躺平或在早期阶段得不到有效学习信号。论文研究如何分解恢复过程，并把仿真特权接触信息转移到仅使用本体感知的真实策略。
contribution: 跌倒恢复是长期自主运行的安全底座。这项工作展示了在支撑点极少的平台上，如何利用训练期接触信息获得部署期可用策略，对安全 locomotion 和故障恢复具有信息价值。
abstract: Fall recovery is critical for autonomous legged locomotion. Existing methods have demonstrated that some legged robots, such as humanoids and quadrupeds, are capable of fall recovery from diverse postures by utilizing arms or coordinating multi-legs to generate support forces. Without arms or other legs to provide supportive assistance, a bipedal-wheeled robot must rely solely on the actuation of its legs, making recovery particularly difficult. To address this, we introduce FTSR (Force-guided T
selectionReason: Interesting fall recovery for armless bipedal-wheeled robots — a niche but important locomotion safety problem. Force-guided teacher-student framework is clever. Real robot deployment and humanoid generalization strengthen claims. However, limited direct relevance to board's core manipulation/VLA focus.

title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
oneLiner: 提出首个实时运行的世界动作模型（WAM），通过统一运动隐空间驱动Unitree G1人形机器人全身协同操作，9项真实任务成功率76.1%，超最强VLA基线32个百分点。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人全身操作（loco-manipulation）需要协调平衡、移动、抓取和物体交互。现有分层范式将上半身关节目标与下半身基础指令分离，限制了腿部只能保持平衡，无法执行任务驱动的足部交互（如踩踏板、踢球）。同时，现有WAM因在高维视频-动作隐空间迭代去噪，速度过慢无法实时运行。
contribution: 该工作首次证明视频预训练WAM可以从桌面操作扩展到全身人形控制，且统一运动隐空间的设计解决了分层架构的根本性局限——腿部从被动平衡器变为主动任务执行器。三阶段训练框架为大规模人形机器人学习提供了可复用的范式。
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands—placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper–lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space.
