A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines finetuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot achieve. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be extended from performing tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.
organizations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
selectionReason: 首个实时运行的全身人形机器人WAM策略，统一运动隐空间消除上下半身解耦，在Unitree G1真实机器人上9项任务整体成功率超最强VLA基线32个百分点。提出三阶段渐进训练框架（egocentric视频预训练→跨embodiment动作后训练→全身微调），解锁了分层策略无法实现的任务驱动足部交互（踢球、踩踏板）。

title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
titleZh: WEAVER：更好、更快、更长的机器人操作世界模型
oneLiner: WEAVER是首个同时满足高保真度、长时域一致性和高效推理三项要求的多视图世界模型，融合扩散forcing、流匹配和预训练编码器，在5项真实操作任务上实现策略评估（ρ=0.91）、改进（+18%）和测试时规划（+23%，比Ctrl-World快8倍）三项能力。
researchQuestion: 世界模型（learned simulators）在机器人领域有巨大潜力——策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划均可通过有限真实交互实现。然而现有机器人世界模型无法同时满足三个核心要求：（i）保真度——预测与真实结果相关；（ii）一致性——长时域预测保持连贯；（iii）效率——快速生成预测。视频生成模型保真度高但效率低，JEPA风格模型无法解码图像以评估任意视觉运动策略，Dreamer-v4缺乏分布外鲁棒性。
contribution: WEAVER证明了通过审慎融合不同社区的关键设计可以实现"鱼与熊掌兼得"的世界模型。其策略评估-改进-规划三位一体能力使world models朝着实用化迈出关键一步。
abstract: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: $\textit{(i)}$ fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), $\textit{(ii)}$ consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), an
selectionReason: 首个同时在fidelity、consistency、efficiency三个维度超越现有方法的机器人操作世界模型。核心贡献：(1)融合flow matching+扩散强制+KV缓存+rectified flow蒸馏实现5-10×速度提升；(2)内置潜在奖励模型和critic消除对外部VLM评判器的依赖；(3)统一支持policy evaluation(ρ=0.870相关性)、improvement(+38%成功率)、planning(+14%成功率)三个下游应用；(4)代码/模型全面开源。相较于看板中已有的WorldGym等世界模型，WEAVER首次实现了真实机器人上的端到端evaluation-improvement-planning闭环。主要风险：依赖π0.5作为基策略，新基策略需要重新训练WM；仅验证Franka单臂任务。

title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
titleZh: Mana：铰接工具的灵巧操作
oneLiner: 将灵巧操作重新定义为动画问题，提出动画启发的通用sim-to-real框架Mana：粗到细pipeline从程序化抓取关键帧→运动规划→强化学习，4种铰接工具上实现zero-shot sim-to-real迁移，数据生成高度自动化。
researchQuestion: 铰接工具操作（如剪刀、钳子、喷雾瓶等）是灵巧机器人的重大挑战：需要协调工具内部的自由度，同时执行接触密集的交互。现有方法各有限制——(a) 依赖有限力度的finger-gaiting，(b) end-to-end RL因高维动作空间和精确功能接触需求而探索困难，(c) 遥操作采集真实演示成本极高。如何在无需大量人类演示和手工设计的条件下，实现可扩展的铰接工具灵巧操作？
contribution: Mana提供了一种全新的视角——将操作定义为动画问题，用计算机图形学的粗到细方法论组织灵巧操作的pipeline。程序化关键帧生成大幅降低了数据标注成本（从遥操作数小时到鼠标点击数秒），有望改变灵巧操作数据的生产范式。zero-shot sim-to-real的成功表明动画启发的轨迹生成+RL精炼的组合可以在不依赖真实世界演示的情况下产生可靠的灵巧操作策略。
abstract: Articulated tool manipulation remains a major challenge in dexterous robotics due to the need to coordinate internal degrees of freedom and contact-rich interactions. While prior work has largely focused on rigid objects, articulated tool use remains underexplored because of its physical complexity and the difficulty of learning functional manipulation strategies. We present Mana (Manipulation Animator), a general sim-to-real framework that reinterprets dexterous manipulation as an animation problem. Inspired by computer animation, Mana employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline that transforms procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning. The data generation process is largely automatic, requiring only a few mouse clicks to specify functional affordances (<1 minute per tool). Across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types, Mana achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for both grasping and in-hand manipulation, demonstrating a scalable approach to dexterous articulated tool use.
selectionReason: 首个将灵巧操作重新定义为动画问题的通用框架。粗到细pipeline：程序化抓取关键帧→运动规划→强化学习。4种铰接工具上实现zero-shot sim-to-real迁移。数据生成高度自动化，每个工具仅需数秒鼠标点击标注功能性affordance。为铰接工具灵巧使用提供了可扩展的scalable方案。

title: SIMPLE: Simulation-Based Policy Learning and Evaluation for Humanoid Loco-manipulation
oneLiner: 首个综合性人形机器人全身操作仿真基准：60项任务×50个场景×1000+物体，MuJoCo+IsaacSim双引擎架构，提供自动化数据采集与标准化评测，实验证明仿真排名与真实世界强相关。
researchQuestion: 人形基础模型发展迅速但缺乏标准化可复现评测。真实世界评测昂贵且难复现，现有仿真基准仅关注桌面或轮式机器人，缺少面向全身操作（loco-manipulation）的综合测试平台。
contribution: 该工作填补了人形机器人全身操作领域标准化评测的关键空白。其双仿真器创新架构解决了MuJoCo物理精度与Isaac Sim视觉真实感不可兼得的长期矛盾。对VLA/WAM社区而言，SIMPLE提供了第一个可复现、可扩展的人形全身操作benchmark，有望加速该方向的研究迭代。
abstract: Humanoid foundation models are advancing faster than we can evaluate them. While real-world testing is expensive and difficult to reproduce, existing simulation benchmarks focus primarily on table-top or wheeled robots. A scalable and reproducible benchmark for whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation remains an open problem. To this end, we present SIMPLE, a unified simulation testbed for humanoid policy learning and evaluation. SIMPLE couples the accurate contact-rich dynamics of MuJoCo with the photorealistic rendering of IsaacSim. It provides a large-scale environment comprising 60 diverse whole-body tasks, 50 indoor scenes, and over 1,000 object assets. To facilitate scalable data collection, the framework integrates two data generation pipelines: automated trajectory generation via motion planning and a low-latency VR teleoperation interface. We further integrate and benchmark mainstream humanoid policies at scale in SIMPLE, including lightweight imitation networks, large vision-language-action (VLA) models, and recent world action models (WAMs). Our experiments reveal a strong correlation between policy performance in simulation and the real world. Furthermore, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected in SIMPLE can be transferred zero-shot to physical humanoid robots under similar settings, providing a robust and reproducible foundation for humanoid robotics research. We will open-source our entire codebase to the community.
selectionReason: 首个综合性人形机器人全身操作仿真基准。60任务/50场景/1000+物体、MuJoCo+IsaacSim双仿真器架构、6000+轨迹，并提供自动化运动规划与VR遥操作数据采集管线。实验证明仿真与真实世界策略性能强相关，支持zero-shot迁移。填补了人形全身操作领域标准化评测的空白。

title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
titleZh: TacCoRL：通过仿真将触觉反馈融入 VLA
oneLiner: TacCoRL 以少量真实触觉数据锚定仿真共训练，再用仿真 RL 学习接触纠错，使四项真实双臂任务成功率从视觉基线的 50.0% 提升到 72.5%。
researchQuestion: VLA 具有视觉、语言和动作先验，但在插入、旋转和装配中，手或物体常遮挡真正的接触区域。直接采集大规模真实触觉数据昂贵，在线真实 RL 又有损坏风险。论文研究能否把真实触觉示范与可扩展仿真结合，让已有 VLA 学会根据接触历史修正动作。
contribution: TacCoRL 给出一条较务实的触觉 VLA 路线：真实数据负责定标，仿真负责探索危险和失败邻域。它说明触觉价值不只是提高感知，而是在视觉被遮挡时提供能改变动作的局部闭环信号。
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key id
selectionReason: Strong tactile VLA framework from prominent labs (Hao Su, Yixin Zhu, Chenfanfu Jiang). Sim-real co-training + RL approach is practical and scalable. 22.5% absolute improvement over vision-only baseline on real bimanual tasks. Project page available. Fills tactile VLA gap on board.

title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
titleZh: 基于 Real2Sim2Real 触觉策略学习的无视觉灵巧抓取
oneLiner: 论文通过触觉校准、几何感知编码和扩散策略蒸馏，让多指灵巧手在完全无视觉、无真实抓取示范的条件下执行真实物体抓取。
researchQuestion: 无视觉抓取适合黑暗、遮挡和狭窄空间，但触觉信号稀疏，同一组接触读数可能对应多种物体姿态；仿真与真实传感器在接触发生和消失的时刻也存在偏差。论文关注如何只依赖触觉与本体状态，将仿真中学习的策略部署到真实 LEAP Hand，而不采集真实抓取示范。
contribution: 它把“触觉可迁移性”拆成接触事件校准、空间表征和多模态控制三个可验证问题，为不依赖摄像头的灵巧操作提供了少见的真实硬件基线。论文价值更多在于明确了当前瓶颈，而不是宣称已经解决盲抓取。
abstract: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that
organizations: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence
selectionReason: Solid Real2Sim2Real framework for blind tactile grasping. Three-component approach (calibration, layout-aware encoder, Diffusion Policy) is well-motivated. Real robot deployment on LEAP Hand with 44-channel tactile sensing across 20 objects. 27% real-world success without vision is a meaningful baseline for tactile-only grasping. Fills tactile-only policy learning gap on the board.

title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning
titleZh: InDex：通过意图条件微调将 VLA 适配到灵巧操作
oneLiner: InDex 把平行夹爪 VLA 的单自由度开合量重释为连续抓取意图，再用独立扩散头解码多指关节，在仿真灵巧基准达到 85.8%。
researchQuestion: 预训练 VLA 多控制低自由度夹爪，直接把输出映射到高自由度灵巧手会造成动作多模态平均和策略崩溃；端到端微调又可能因少量灵巧数据破坏已有空间语义。论文研究如何保留 VLA 的臂运动与语义先验，只单独学习手指动作。
contribution: InDex 提供了一个简洁跨形态接口：不要求原 VLA 直接理解每个手指，而让它输出宏观意图。这对复用现有夹爪 VLA 很有现实意义。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable zero-shot generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the vast majority of pre-trained pipelines remain strictly confined to low-DoF parallel grippers. Adapting these rich semantic priors to high-DoF dexterous hands introduces a severe morphology gap, direct end-to-end joint fine-tuning inherently causes catastrophic forgetting of spatial reasoning and acute action manifold collapse due to data scarcity. In this paper, we present I
selectionReason: 巧妙解决VLA从低DoF平行夹爪到高DoF灵巧手迁移的形态鸿沟。核心创新：(1)将预训练VLA的1-DoF抓取输出重新定义为连续的宏观虚拟抓取意图代理，实现跨形态语义继承；(2)两阶段解耦学习：第一阶段参数高效对齐VLA预测臂轨迹+标量抓取意图，第二阶段冻结空间骨干用意图条件扩散头解码手指关节；(3)无需大量灵巧手数据，用最少演示数据掌握复杂技能。85.8%成功率。相较于看板中已有的灵巧操作工作(RealDexUMI、ConTrack)，InDex从VLA形态适配角度提供了独特贡献。北航+中国空间技术研究院。主要风险：仅在仿真中验证，未展示真实灵巧手硬件结果；意图代理的定义可能对手型敏感。

title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
titleZh: World Pilot：用世界—动作先验引导 VLA
oneLiner: World Pilot 通过潜空间和动作空间两条通路把 WAM 的场景演化与预期轨迹注入 VLA，在 LIBERO-Plus 达到 84.7%，并提升四项真实分布外操作。
researchQuestion: VLA 的语义知识主要来自静态图文预训练，难以理解接触过程与动作后果。世界—动作模型可以想象未来，但把生成视频直接用于规划计算昂贵，也不清楚应该在感知还是动作层融合。论文研究如何将 WAM 先验路由进 VLA 决策链。
contribution: World Pilot 提供一种比测试时完整视频想象更轻量的利用方式：把世界模型内部先验注入现有 VLA。它说明世界模型的价值可能不只在显式 rollout，也在表征和动作先验。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit semantic grounding from large-scale pretraining and perform competently across in-distribution manipulation tasks. This grounding, however, is built on static image-text pairs, whereas manipulation is a continuous, contact-rich process whose dynamics this pretraining cannot capture. We present World Pilot, a VLA framework that augments the policy with priors from a World-Action Model (WAM), routed into the decision chain through two complementary pathw
selectionReason: 创新的双通路WAM增强VLA框架。核心贡献：(1)Latent Steering将WAM的场景演化预测注入VLA感知层，Action Steering将预期轨迹注入动作层，两条通路互补；(2)即使使用未action-post-trained的纯视频预训练WAM，Latent Steering仍然有效——大幅降低了WAM部署门槛；(3)84.7% LIBERO-Plus SOTA，真实机器人所有任务最高成功率。相较于看板中已有的VLA增强方法(PhysVLA推理时修正、Object-Centric Residual RL)，World Pilot从WAM先验注入角度提供了全新维度。中科院自动化所+北航+南大合作。主要风险：代码未明确开源；WAM训练需要额外计算资源。

title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
titleZh: EgoEngine：从自我中心人类视频到高保真灵巧机器人演示
oneLiner: 提出可扩展框架EgoEngine：将自我中心人类操作视频转化为高保真机器人数据，同时解决视觉差异（数字孪生视频生成）和动作差异（可执行轨迹生成），首次实现无需真实机器人演示的zero-shot灵巧视觉运动策略学习。
researchQuestion: 自我中心人类视频是灵巧操作数据的可扩展来源，但直接用于机器人学习需要跨越两大鸿沟：(1) 视觉鸿沟——人类手与机器人手的外观截然不同；(2) 动作鸿沟——人类手部运动与机器人可执行动作之间存在具身和动力学不匹配。现有方法要么仅解决视觉问题（掩码/视频编辑），要么仅解决动作问题（retargeting/RL优化），缺乏同时处理两者的统一框架。
contribution: EgoEngine代表了"从人类视频学习机器人技能"方向的重要突破。与Video2Sim2Real从第三人称视频重建不同，EgoEngine从第一人称视角出发，更贴近真实机器人部署场景。同时解决视觉和动作两大鸿沟的统一框架，为人类视频到机器人数据的规模化转换提供了完整的技术路线。zero-shot的声明如果属实，意味着灵巧操作策略可以完全脱离昂贵的人类遥操作数据采集。
abstract: Dexterous manipulation is limited by the cost of collecting large-scale robot demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors, but directly using them for robot learning requires bridging two gaps: the visual gap between human and robot observations, and the action gap between human motion and robot-executable action. We propose EgoEngine, a scalable framework for transforming egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot data. Given an egocentric RGB video, EgoEngine produces: (i) a high-fidelity robot observation video replacing human with robot while preserving scene context and temporal alignment, and (ii) a task-aligned, executable robot action trajectory under feasibility constraints. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that EgoEngine enables scalable conversion of human videos into robot data and, to our knowledge, demonstrates the first zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from egocentric human videos without real-robot demonstrations.
selectionReason: 首个从自我中心人类视频到灵巧机器人演示的zero-shot视觉运动策略学习框架。同时解决视觉差异（digital twin视频生成）和动作差异（可执行轨迹生成）两大鸿沟。在人形机器人上实现zero-shot灵巧操作，无需任何真实机器人演示。

title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
titleZh: SARM2：面向自改进机器人操作的多任务阶段感知奖励建模
oneLiner: 通过动作基元阶段估计器+多门MoE价值头构建多任务密集奖励模型，将价值估计MSE降低80%；结合SPIRAL自改进框架，在真实机器人上实现折叠短裤58%→100%、清洁白板50%→90%的显著提升。
researchQuestion: 长程操作中微调VLA策略仍依赖行为克隆，需要昂贵的高质量演示且策略被限制在演示分布附近。奖励模型可以减少这种依赖，但现有方法存在两难：任务特定阶段感知模型准确但需要逐任务标注，通用VLM奖励模型适用性广但对细粒度长程进度过于粗糙。如何构建既准确又通用的密集奖励模型？
contribution: 该工作解决了VLA策略自我改进的核心瓶颈——高质量密集奖励的获取。动作基元作为任务无关中间表示的设计使奖励模型可跨任务复用，MMoE架构保证了多任务下的专业化。SPIRAL证明了高质量密集奖励是实现稳定机器人数据飞轮的关键，对VLA社区的规模化部署有重要参考价值。
abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) policies for long-horizon manipulation still relies heavily on behavior cloning, which requires costly high-quality demonstrations and keeps policies near the demonstration distribution. Reward models can reduce this dependence by reweighting demonstrations and providing dense supervision for on-robot reinforcement learning (RL), but they must be dense, accurate, and general. Existing methods fall short: task-specific stage-aware models are accurate but require per-task annotations, while general vision-language-model (VLM) reward models are broadly applicable but too coarse for fine-grained long-horizon progress. We introduce SARM2, a multi-task stage-aware reward model that combines an action-primitive-based stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) value head to produce dense per-step rewards across manipulation tasks. Building on SARM2, we further propose SPIRAL (Self-Policy Improvement via Reward-Aligned Learning), an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts. On a 10-task benchmark, SARM2 reduces value-estimation MSE by 80% over the strongest baselines; when used in SPIRAL, it improves task success from around 50% to near-perfect performance on Folding Shorts (58% to 100%) and Cleaning Whiteboard (50% to 90%), showing that high-quality dense rewards are key to a stable robot data flywheel.
selectionReason: 提出基于动作基元的多任务阶段感知奖励模型SARM2和自改进框架SPIRAL。SARM2通过动作基元阶段估计器+多门MoE价值头在不需任务特定标注的情况下生成密集逐步奖励，在10任务基准上MSE降低80%。SPIRAL利用密集奖励驱动VLA策略从自主rollout中自我改进，实现Folding Shorts 58%→100%、Cleaning Whiteboard 50%→90%的显著提升。为机器人数据飞轮提供了关键组件。

title: GuideWalk: Learning Unified Autonomous Navigation and Locomotion for Humanoid Robots across Versatile Terrains
titleZh: GuideWalk：面向多样地形的人形机器人统一导航与运动学习
oneLiner: GuideWalk 用可穿越性感知速度引导连接高层避障与低层地形运动，再以教师蒸馏和 RL 微调训练统一人形导航策略。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人可能分别具备行走和导航能力，但高层路径若忽略动力学可行性，机器人会在楼梯、窄梁或障碍附近产生无法执行的命令。直接端到端学习又容易把目标导航、避障和稳定行走纠缠在一起。论文希望以中间速度指令解耦决策，同时最终得到单一部署策略。
contribution: GuideWalk 的信息价值在于中间接口设计：速度引导既比路径点更接近动力学，又比关节动作更便于规划。它为人形机器人将“去哪儿”和“怎么走”统一训练提供了清晰范式。
abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved strong locomotion capabilities, but reliable navigation on versatile terrains remains challenging because obstacle avoidance must be coordinated with dynamically feasible motion. In this work, we present GuideWalk, a unified end-to-end framework that integrates traversability-aware navigation guidance with terrain-adaptive locomotion teacher for humanoid navigation. Specifically, we introduce a navigation module that provides explicit velocity guidance, decoupling o
selectionReason: 针对人形机器人在复杂地形上的统一导航与运动协调问题，提出GuideWalk框架——结合可穿越性感知导航引导与地形自适应运动教师的端到端方案。核心贡献：(1)导航模块提供显式速度引导，将避障与地形条件解耦；(2)复合教师蒸馏方案聚合目标导向命令与动力学一致动作；(3)RL+BC辅助精炼提升鲁棒性。在楼梯、斜坡、窄梁等场景验证。相较看板中的人形机器人工作(如SIMPLE基准、MotionWAM)，GuideWalk更侧重感知-导航-运动的端到端耦合而非仿真评估协议或世界模型。主要风险：仅仿真实验无真实机器人验证，代码未确认开源。

title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
titleZh: Embodied-R1.5：基于具身基础模型的物理智能进化
oneLiner: 提出统一具身基础模型(EFM)，8B参数融合认知、规划与指向三大能力维度于单架构，PGC闭环框架实现自主规划-执行-纠错，24项基准16项SOTA，少量动作数据微调即超越π₀.₅等VLA模型。
researchQuestion: 具身智能面临三个核心瓶颈：(1) 现有模型能力碎片化——各自只覆盖认知、规划或指向的部分维度；(2) 多任务冲突——长文本推理、轨迹预测、语义定位等异构任务联合训练时收敛困难；(3) 缺乏在长周期任务上的闭环自主验证——大多数EFM停留在具身问答层面，未验证推理能力能否真正支撑物理世界中的复杂决策。
contribution: Embodied-R1.5是首个将认知推理、任务规划和物理指向三大能力真正统一于单个模型中的EFM。其核心洞察——当VLM充分内化具身推理能力后，下游动作学习对大规模动作预训练的需求可大幅降低——为具身基础模型的训练范式提供了重要参考。多任务均衡RL配方的设计解决了异构任务联合训练的收敛难题。完全开源的生态系统为社区研究EFM提供了前所未有的基础设施。
abstract: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like π₀.₅ across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.
selectionReason: 首个统一认知、规划与指向三大维度的具身基础模型(EFM)：8B参数在24个具身VLM基准中16项SOTA，平均70.4%超越Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5达17%。PGC闭环框架实现单模型自主规划-执行-纠错。小量动作数据微调即可超越π0.5等VLA模型。完全开源（权重、数据、代码、EmbodiedEvalKit评估框架）。

title: PLUME: Probabilistic Latent Unified World Modeling and Parameter Estimation for Multi-Finger Manipulation
titleZh: PLUME：多指操作的概率潜在统一世界建模与参数估计
oneLiner: PLUME 在同一潜变量模型中联合预测动力学并在线维护物理参数分布，使多指手能在未知形状、姿态和摩擦下规划精密动作。
researchQuestion: 多指操作对物体几何、初始姿态和摩擦非常敏感。域随机化策略在部署时并不知道当前参数，往往对所有情况采取折中动作；普通世界模型又可能把参数不确定性混入状态噪声。论文研究如何从短期接触历史推断一组可能的物理参数，并让规划显式考虑这种概率信念。
contribution: 这项工作把“世界模型预测什么”从未来图像或状态扩展到可解释的物理参数信念。对精密灵巧操作而言，知道自己不确定的是摩擦还是形状，可能比单一隐状态更有助于安全规划。
abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-finger hands can be sensitive to physical parameters such as object shape, pose, and friction coefficients. While simulation enables large-scale data collection with known parameter values, simulation-trained policies must still handle uncertainty at deployment, where the true parameters and therefore the true dynamics are unknown. Standard domain randomization strategies may be insufficient for precise tasks like screwdriver turning, as manipulation strategies
selectionReason: Novel world model approach for dexterous manipulation under parameter uncertainty. Joint belief+dynamic modeling with online inference is elegant. Hardware screwdriver turning validates sim-to-real. Outperforms offline RL and BC baselines. Fills world model gap on board.

title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
titleZh: YUBI：面向规模化双臂灵巧操作的顺应式双指通用接口
oneLiner: YUBI 用与拇指—食指对齐的顺应式夹具替代 UMI 手枪握把，并发布覆盖 119 项任务、985 条轨迹的双臂数据与开源硬件。
researchQuestion: UMI 等手持采集器成本低，但手枪式握把体积大，在螺母、插线和精细双臂任务中限制手腕与指尖。论文研究能否让采集器更接近人类双指捏取，使操作者直接利用手指灵巧性，同时保持可追踪、可复现的机器人末端。
contribution: 它说明数据接口的人体工学会直接影响轨迹质量和采集吞吐。YUBI 不追求更复杂执行器，而是通过更自然的握持方式改进规模化数据生产。
abstract: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yie
selectionReason: 通过创新的手指对齐式夹爪设计改进UMI范式。核心贡献：(1)手指对齐(yielding bidigital)握持方式替代UMI手枪式握把，显著提升人体工学和精细操作可及性；(2)YUBI-Bench: 119个任务、985条轨迹的大规模双臂灵巧数据集；(3)硬件、软件、数据集全面开源。相较于看板中已有的UMI和RealDexUMI，YUBI从人体工学改进角度提供了一个有价值的替代方案。主要局限：YUBI仍然是平行夹爪范式(非多指灵巧手)，任务复杂度和数据规模(985条轨迹)相对有限。

title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
titleZh: GEAR-VLA：学习几何感知动作表征以泛化机器人操作
oneLiner: GEAR-VLA 通过连续潜动作、语义对齐三维特征和具身规范化学习共享几何动作表征，在仿真与两种真实机器人上提升跨物体、背景和本体泛化。
researchQuestion: VLA 在标准基准上表现强，但容易依赖腕部视角、机器人状态和训练背景，对未见物体或新机器人失效。论文认为根因是缺少统一几何动作表示：互联网视频没有机器人动作，多机器人数据动作空间不一致，二维 VLM 表征又未与三维操作空间对齐。
contribution: 它把 VLA 泛化问题具体化为几何、动作语义和本体接口三个层次，并用较大真实评测验证。相比只增加数据量，GEAR-VLA 提供了更结构化的跨具身方案。
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware ac
organizations: University of Science and Technology of China
selectionReason: 针对VLA模型在实际部署中的泛化瓶颈，提出GEAR-VLA——通过几何感知动作表征实现跨物体、跨背景、跨具身的泛化操作。核心贡献：(1)粗到细动作学习——多源具身预训练+梯度解耦DiT专家；(2)语义对齐3D集成——3D空间骨干与VLM表征对齐；(3)具身规范化——跨机器人共享表征。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0、真实AgileX和未见LDT-01上均达SOTA或强性能，6360次通用抓取基准90.1%成功率。相较于看板中其他VLA工作（如OpenVLA、π0.5），GEAR-VLA在几何感知和跨具身泛化方面提供明确增量。

title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
titleZh: HARBOR：面向智能体机器人强化学习的 Harness 框架
oneLiner: HARBOR 以标准化命令、工件、可执行门和经验库组织多个智能体，自动完成机器人 RL 的环境配置、奖励设计、训练调参与真实部署准备。
researchQuestion: 机器人 RL 的主要成本往往不在算法本身，而在依赖安装、任务实现、奖励塑形、训练诊断、超参数搜索和渲染验证。把这些工作交给一个长上下文智能体容易产生隐蔽错误，也无法稳定复用经验。论文把自动化问题重新定义为 harness engineering：为智能体建立有边界、可验证的操作环境。
contribution: 机器人 RL 规模化需要的不只是新算法，也需要让工程流程可审计。HARBOR 对命令权限、产物和验证门的强调尤其值得关注，因为它把“智能体写代码”转换为可重复的实验系统。
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for robot learning, particularly in sim-to-real settings, but its broader adoption remains limited by the engineering pipeline surrounding the algorithms. Building tasks, shaping rewards, and tuning hyperparameters require substantial expert effort, making RL workflows costly and difficult to scale. We introduce HARBOR, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a
selectionReason: 将机器人RL工作流自动化视为'harness-engineering'问题，提出HARBOR智能体框架。核心贡献：(1)将任务分解为有界阶段由专门智能体执行；(2)标准化命令-工件-门-知识体系；(3)去中心化并行试验+跨运行经验学习。在6个基准16个任务上端到端自动化，奖励设计匹配或超越专家配置，策略可迁移到真实机器人。填补了看板中RL基础设施自动化方向的重要空白。主要风险：智能体框架依赖LLM API成本，开源状态未确认。

title: Unifying Object-Centric World Models and Diffusion Policy: A Hierarchical Framework for Multi-Stage Robotic Tasks
titleZh: WorldDP：统一物体中心世界模型与扩散策略的多阶段操作框架
oneLiner: WorldDP 用物体中心世界模型在高层规划可行子目标，再由目标条件扩散策略执行，在 OGBench 四类多阶段任务中优于图像级规划基线。
researchQuestion: 视觉世界模型常被用于 MPC，但大多只处理到达或抓取等单阶段任务。多阶段操作需要追踪不同对象及其先后关系，直接在整幅图像潜空间规划容易被背景干扰，也难以表示多种可行计划。论文研究如何将长时域预测与可靠的短时动作执行解耦。
contribution: 它把世界模型最擅长的结构化长期预测与扩散策略最擅长的局部动作生成分开使用，并明确利用对象作为规划单位。这种层次组合比让单一模型同时承担长时推演和低层控制更容易诊断。
abstract: Visual world models have shown great potential in learning complex system dynamics. Recent advancements leverage these models as transition functions within Model Predictive Control (MPC) frameworks to solve various control tasks. When applied to robotics, however, they are limited to single-stage tasks such as reaching or grasping, and struggle with multi-stage ones that demand complex sequential planning. In this work, we introduce WorldDP, a world model framework designed for multi-stage robo
selectionReason: 将物体中心世界模型与扩散策略统一到层次化框架中处理多阶段机器人操作。核心贡献：(1)高层物体中心世界模型在粒子滤波内优化子目标；(2)低层目标条件扩散策略执行；(3)物体中心表示实现序列规划。在OGBench多阶段任务上超越基线。方法设计巧妙，但实验规模有限（4个任务变体，单机器人平台），且仅仿真验证。

title: Video2Sim2Real: Full-Stack Autonomous Dexterous Skill Acquisition from a Single Human Video
titleZh: Video2Sim2Real：从单个人类视频中全栈自主获取灵巧技能
oneLiner: 提出全栈框架Video2Sim2Real：从单个人类操作视频出发，通过数字孪生重建、object-centric关键帧优化和decoupled IL/RL sim-to-real策略，实现灵巧技能自主获取，7项任务仿真成功率91.4%，真实世界成功率95.7%。
researchQuestion: 人类操作视频是机器人学习的便捷数据源，但直接将人类灵巧性迁移到机器人面临两大挑战：(1) 感知误差——从视频重建场景时的几何不精确性导致retargeted轨迹不可靠；(2) 具身差异——人手与机器人手在形态和动力学上的巨大鸿沟。现有方法要么被低质量retargeted轨迹限制，要么因高维状态空间难以探索。如何在无需真实机器人数据的前提下，从单个人类视频中自主获取可靠的灵巧操作技能？
contribution: Video2Sim2Real代表了"从人类视频学习机器人技能"方向的重要进展。其核心洞察——object-centric关键帧作为可靠锚点而非依赖全轨迹——解决了retargeted轨迹质量不足的根本问题。Decoupled IL/RL sim-to-real策略为处理感知误差与交互动力学的不同难度提供了一个优雅的分离方案。全栈自动化意味着无需人工遥操作或真实机器人演示，大幅降低了灵巧技能获取的门槛。
abstract: Human manipulation videos are a convenient and intuitive source for robot learning. However, directly transferring human dexterity to robots remains challenging due to perception errors and the embodiment gap. To address this, we introduce Video2Sim2Real, a full-stack framework for autonomous skill acquisition from a single human manipulation video. Our framework first uses off-the-shelf foundation models to reconstruct a simulator-ready digital twin and extract robot and object motion priors. Rather than treating the extracted robot motion as a reliable reference throughout execution, our key idea is to recover and leverage the most fundamental sources of supervision from the demonstrated skill: We identify object-centric keyframes to optimize the corresponding robot configurations using object information from the simulator, and use these configurations as anchors that refine the robot motion such that it ultimately has the desired impact on the environment. To bridge the remaining sim-to-real gap, we introduce a sim-to-real strategy that decouples robustness to noisy and incomplete perception from variations in hand-object interaction dynamics. Specifically, we learn to recalibrate robot configurations from noisy real-world point clouds via IL, and leverage residual RL to perform local finger-level adaptations to ensure robust and effective interactions. Finally, a collision-aware motion planning module enables spatial generalization to novel object configurations.
selectionReason: 单个人类视频→全栈自主灵巧技能获取的完整pipeline：object-centric keyframe refinement + decoupled IL/RL sim-to-real策略，7项日常操作任务仿真91.4%/真实95.7%成功率。首次实现从单个人类视频无需真实机器人演示即可获得灵巧操作技能。

title: X-OP: Cross-Morphology Whole-Body Teleoperation via MPC Retargeting
titleZh: X-OP：通过 MPC 重定向实现跨形态全身遥操作
oneLiner: X-OP 用单个 XR 设备采集人类目标，以数字孪生 MPC 在运行时重定向到不同机器人，并通过状态同步兼容现有低层控制器。
researchQuestion: 全身移动操作数据常依赖昂贵外骨骼或多相机，单 XR+学习策略虽轻量，却需为每种机器人重训，并可能在分布外动作失效。直接几何映射又忽略平衡、碰撞和动力学。论文研究能否用在线优化把人类意图转换为跨形态可执行状态。
contribution: X-OP 的价值在于让同一遥操作输入跨不同身体复用，并保留动力学约束，适合作为全身数据采集的通用中间层。
abstract: Whole-body teleoperation is essential for scalable robot data collection in loco-manipulation tasks, yet existing approaches relying on exoskeleton suits or multi-camera setups impose prohibitive cost, complexity, and environmental constraints. Recent methods using a single extended reality (XR) device with end-to-end reinforcement learning policies partially address these limitations but require robot-specific retraining, suffer from out-of-distribution failures, and rely on motion retargeting
selectionReason: Practical cross-morphology teleoperation framework that works with existing low-level controllers; MPC-based retargeting with dynamic feasibility is a clean engineering contribution; validated on two different robot platforms.

title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
titleZh: Ego-Pi：面向自我中心人类与机器人数据的VLA微调
oneLiner: 探索利用自我中心人类数据微调VLA模型赋能灵巧手人形机器人：基于π0.5，通过交错式双手动作序列解决58维灵巧手动作超限问题，以彩色骨架线对齐跨具身视觉，验证人类数据可传授机器人数据中不存在的高级任务语义和技能组合。
researchQuestion: 机器人操作面临数据稀缺的根本挑战——不存在互联网规模的机器人数据集。自我中心人类数据更易采集、覆盖面广、规模更大。但如何弥合人类与灵巧手人形机器人之间的具身鸿沟，使VLA模型能从人类数据中学习任务语义和技能组合？
contribution: 利用人类数据扩展机器人数据是解决数据稀缺最有前景的方向之一。Ego-Pi在VLA微调范式下的系统性研究——从动作对齐、视觉对齐到数据混合——为后续工作提供了实用的设计参考。特别是交错式动作序列技巧，展示了在不修改预训练架构的前提下适配高维动作空间的巧妙方案。
abstract: Robotics faces a fundamental challenge of data scarcity. Unlike language or vision research, there is no internet-scale dataset for robotic manipulation. A promising path forward is to leverage egocentric human data, which can be collected more easily, with greater breadth, and at a larger scale. Towards this end, we investigate key design choices for learning across human and humanoid embodiments equipped with dexterous five-finger hands, using the π0.5 model as a foundation. Our results show that human data enables robots to learn new task semantics and compose existing skills into novel behaviors without corresponding robot data.
selectionReason: 探索利用自我中心人类数据微调VLA模型以赋能灵巧手人形机器人。基于π0.5模型，研究跨人-机器人具身学习的关键设计选择：动作空间对齐（交错式双手动作序列解决灵巧手58维超限问题）、视觉对齐（彩色骨架线叠加）和数据混合策略。在番茄分拣（颜色规则）、包装（技能组合）和装箱（顺序规则）三个任务上验证人类数据可传授机器人数据中不存在的高级任务语义。

title: Mind Your Steps: A General Learning Framework for Accurate Humanoid Foothold Tracking
titleZh: Mind Your Steps：精确人形机器人落脚点跟踪的通用学习框架
oneLiner: 论文用三维目标采样器和支撑脚相对坐标训练轻量落脚策略，使 Booster T1 无需精确基座状态即可在窄路、楼梯和坡面零样本真实跟踪脚步目标。
researchQuestion: 速度命令人形策略很稳，但无法保证脚落在指定位置，可能踩到人脚、越出窄路，或因站位误差影响后续操作。已有落脚策略常依赖准确全局基座姿态和显式接触估计，真实部署容易漂移。论文研究如何用局部、稳定的目标表示学习可插接高层规划器的落脚模块。
contribution: 精确落脚是速度控制与任务级全身规划之间缺失的接口。该方法用简单局部坐标降低真实部署要求，对人形机器人在拥挤和窄空间安全移动很实用。
abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to operate in complex, dynamic environments remains a critical challenge, fundamentally limited by the ability to navigate robustly, safely, and accurately. While reinforcement learning with velocity-commanded policies has achieved remarkable robustness in humanoid locomotion, this approach lacks explicit control of the foothold placement, leading to unsafe behavior, such as stepping onto human feet, or imprecise navigation, hindering the following manipulation task. Con
organizations: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
selectionReason: Solid foothold-tracking framework for humanoids with real-world validation; modular design enables pairing with different high-level planners; stance-relative commands are a practical design choice for real deployment.

title: Spline Policy: A Structured Representation for Robot Policies
titleZh: Spline Policy：机器人策略的结构化样条表示
oneLiner: Spline Policy 用少量样条参数替代固定分辨率动作块，在不改策略骨干的情况下获得连续轨迹、任意时间重采样、局部流场修正和不确定性传播。
researchQuestion: 动作块简单有效，但在执行前缺少显式几何和时间结构；重规划时相邻块可能速度不连续，也难以适配不同控制频率。传统运动基元结构强，却常与现代扩散、VLA 骨干割裂。论文研究能否只替换输出对象，把结构控制能力加入现有策略。
contribution: 它在现代端到端策略与经典轨迹表示之间建立了干净接口，使学习模型输出更容易被实时控制、安全约束和不同频率系统使用。
abstract: Modern imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation often represent actions as fixed-resolution action chunks, which are simple and effective but expose limited geometric and temporal structure before execution. This paper studies Spline Policy (SP), a structured representation that replaces action chunks with spline parameters while keeping the policy backbone unchanged. The predicted spline can be decoded as a compact continuous trajectory, queried at different temporal resolutions, cons
selectionReason: Clean theoretical contribution bridging movement primitives and modern policy learning; spline-based output is a drop-in improvement across multiple backbones; flow-field realization provides principled local correction.

title: Affordance-Based Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Pedipulation
titleZh: 基于可供性的四足机器人分层强化学习腿部操作
oneLiner: 论文把导航、移动和腿部操作组织为三级系统，并根据地形与目标表面自动选择机身落位和接触点，使 Unitree Go2 能在非结构环境中自主接近并推动物体。
researchQuestion: 四足机器人可以用腿兼作末端执行器，但许多系统仍依赖人工指定机身位置、接触点和高层轨迹。若落位过远、地面坡度不合适或接触面不可用，即使低层腿部策略稳定也无法完成任务。论文研究如何让机器人根据目标几何与局部地形，自主选择“从哪里站、碰哪里”，再协调导航、行走和腿部操作。
contribution: 它补上了腿部操作系统常被忽略的高层决策：操作成功不仅是末端策略问题，也取决于机器人如何接近目标。将落位和接触点显式建模，对移动操作和全身控制系统都有参考价值。
abstract: The object manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots is an open research challenge. While previous studies have focused on low-level policy learning, task execution still relies on expert-designed high-level trajectories. Autonomous selection of both an affordable interaction point on the target object and an affordable robot base pose removes the need for pre-designed trajectories. This study proposes a three-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes pose afford
selectionReason: Interesting hierarchical RL approach for quadruped pedipulation using affordances. Three-level hierarchy (navigation, locomotion, pedipulation) is well-structured. Real-world validation. Code available at github.com/eppl-erau-db/go2_rl_ws. Fills quadruped manipulation gap on the board.

title: DexFuture: Hierarchical Future-State Visuomotor Targeting for Bimanual Dexterous Tool Use
titleZh: DexFuture：面向双臂灵巧工具使用的分层未来状态视觉运动定位
oneLiner: DexFuture通过分层架构解决双手灵巧工具使用的未来参考轨迹生成瓶颈：高层未来状态视觉运动目标预测器从RGB和本体感知历史直接预测多步未来目标，低层目标条件结构化灵巧策略跟踪执行，在OakInk2工具使用任务上恢复特权oracle性能的大部分，同时比DexWM式CEM规划快9倍。
researchQuestion: 双手灵巧工具使用依赖未来参考轨迹（手部动作、物体位姿、指尖关系等）来使高维控制可处理，但这些参考是特权信息——部署时机器人仅有当前观测而无未来演示状态。替代方案是学习动作条件世界模型并用在线规划（如CEM）选择未来动作，但对灵巧工具使用而言，高维动作序列的在线优化计算成本过高，无法达到接触丰富控制所需的高频。
contribution: DexFuture抓住了灵巧操作中的核心矛盾——未来参考轨迹极有价值但部署时不可得。通过action-free预测替代在线规划的思路优雅且实用，"快预测+快执行"替代"慢规划+慢执行"的设计哲学对实时灵巧控制系统具有普适参考价值。
abstract: Bimanual dexterous tool use remains challenging for robots due to high-dimensional hand configurations and complex hand-tool-object dynamics and contact. Most existing control policies depend on future configuration references provided from demonstrations, while future action-conditioned world models require slow online planning over high-dimensional action sequences. A significant challenge is generating a dynamically consistent future reference trajectory without relying on privileged states f
selectionReason: Elegant hierarchical approach to dexterous tool use that removes privileged demonstration dependency; 250x faster than planning baselines while maintaining near-oracle performance — addresses a key bottleneck in dexterous manipulation.

title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
titleZh: LadderMan：学习人形机器人感知爬梯
oneLiner: 利用视觉基础模型与混合模仿/强化学习，从单条参考运动训练出统一深度视觉运动策略，使Unitree G1人形机器人在无硬件改装条件下零样本迁移至多种真实爬梯，并支持梯上稳定操作。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人在工业巡检、建造与维护场景中需要爬梯并执行操作，但爬梯因稀疏接触点、全身协调要求高、感知与控制误差敏感而极具挑战。此前方法多依赖无感知的模型控制，需要精确环境建模与任务特定调参，泛化能力差，且不涉及梯上操作。本文探讨：能否学习一个视觉运动系统，使无硬件改装的人形机器人稳健攀爬多样化梯子并执行梯上操作？
contribution: 该工作首次将学习基感知控制成功应用于人形爬梯这一DARPA挑战赛级别的困难任务，证明视觉基础模型可以有效弥合稀疏结构感知的sim-to-real鸿沟。两阶段蒸馏框架和双智能体操作架构为高维全身人形控制提供了可扩展范式。
abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present LadderMan, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints.
selectionReason: 首个将视觉感知驱动的强化学习应用于人形机器人爬梯任务的工作。提出混合运动追踪+混合模仿/RL两阶段训练框架，从单条参考运动学习多专家策略并蒸馏为统一深度视觉运动策略。利用视觉基础模型弥合深度感知的sim-to-real鸿沟，实现零样本迁移至真实H1人形机器人，并支持梯上遥操作。爬梯速度与人类相当（~3.4 s/rung）。

title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
titleZh: 世界-语言-动作模型：统一世界建模、语言推理与动作合成
oneLiner: WLA提出新型具身基础模型范式，将世界模型的语言推理能力引入VLA框架，通过AR Transformer同时预测文本子任务、子目标图像和机器人动作，World Expert将物理动态预测与动作生成解耦，WLA-0以2B参数在RTX 5090上实现40ms推理延迟。
researchQuestion: 世界-动作模型（WAM）通过世界建模接口受益于大规模自我中心视频预训练，但仅预测下一视觉状态，被低层细节所累，限制了语义推理和外推能力。VLA模型具备语言推理但缺乏物理动态预测的强先验。如何统一两者的优势是一个开放问题。
contribution: WLA解决了WAM的语义瓶颈——通过引入文本意图预测使世界模型具备语言推理能力。端到端训练、推理时World Expert可选的灵活设计兼顾了性能和效率。在RMBench长时域记忆任务上近两倍的提升表明语言推理对复杂规划的增益。
abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the \emph{world modeling interface} to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the \emph{language reasoning} capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA li
selectionReason: 开创性地提出World-Language-Action (WLA)模型类别，首次将世界建模、语言推理和动作合成统一为单一AR Transformer。核心贡献：(1)用AR Transformer替代WAM中传统的双向扩散Transformer，实现更自然的序列建模；(2)世界预测通过meta-queries隐式影响动作生成，推理时可完全禁用(零开销)或激活用于test-time scaling；(3)World Expert提供物理动态监督，Action Expert利用世界预测简化状态-动作关联学习；(4)WLA-0原型在RoboTwin2.0达到92.94%、RMBench 56.5%的SOTA性能，40ms推理延迟。相较于看板中已有的VLA(π0, OpenVLA)和WAM(MotionWAM)，WLA提供了全新的统一范式。代码完全开源。主要风险：2B参数量在RTX 5090上运行，部署门槛较高；RMBench 56.5%的绝对分仍有提升空间。

title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
titleZh: RealDexUMI：面向灵巧机器人学习的可穿戴通用操作接口
oneLiner: RealDexUMI 让同一个灵巧手模块同时充当可穿戴采集器和机器人末端，消除手型重定向，并以触觉增强示范在多类真实任务上取得 88.75% 平均成功率。
researchQuestion: 灵巧示范在采集时常使用手套或不同 leader 装置，部署时再映射到机器人手，细粒度接触会因形态和关节差异丢失。机器人专用遥操作又难以跨平台扩展。论文提出“共享末端”思路：人和机器人使用完全相同的灵巧手硬件。
contribution: 它从硬件接口而非算法上消除 embodiment gap：采集设备就是执行器。对需要精密接触的数据管线，这是非常直接而有力的设计。
abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector modu
selectionReason: 创新的共享灵巧手接口设计。核心贡献：(1)同一灵巧手模块作为可穿戴采集设备和机器人末端执行器，彻底消除实施例转换和重定向误差；(2)零间隙采集-部署管线，直接从人类手指运动映射到机器人手指运动；(3)内置触觉传感丰富数据模态；(4)天然支持跨实施例部署。88.75%成功率，多种难度任务验证。相较于看板中已有的数据采集方案(UMI手枪式、YUBI手指对齐式)，RealDexUMI从共享末端执行器角度提供了独特的零间隙范式。北大+BeingBeyond合作。主要风险：灵巧手硬件来自BeingBeyond(商业公司)；目前仅展示了特定灵巧手。

title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
titleZh: MotionDisco：面向极限人形移动操作的运动发现框架
oneLiner: MotionDisco 通过 LLM 引导的进化搜索与动力学轨迹优化，在无需任何人类演示的条件下，自主发现并部署长序列人形移动操作行为，首次在真实硬件上实现了从零开始的全身运动技能发现。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人的长序列移动操作（如搬箱爬梯、推柜行走）面临两个核心难题：（1）可能接触交互的组合空间随任务长度和场景物体数量呈指数增长；（2）现有方法严重依赖人类遥操作或运动重定向，难以扩展到未见过的任务组合。如何在无人类演示的条件下，自主发现复杂全身运动序列并部署到真实人形机器人，仍是一个开放挑战。
contribution: MotionDisco 代表了一种范式转变：从"人类先演示、机器人再学习"转向"机器人自主探索可能的行为空间"。这种自主运动发现能力对于人形机器人在开放世界中的长期自主性至关重要。LLM 作为语义先验指导物理搜索的思路也具有广泛的方法论意义。
abstract: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences
selectionReason: Groundbreaking approach to humanoid skill discovery — first to autonomously discover and execute long-horizon loco-manipulation on real hardware without human demonstrations; LLM-guided evolutionary search is a novel paradigm for robot motion synthesis.

title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
titleZh: TempoVLA：学习速度可控的视觉—语言—动作策略
oneLiner: TempoVLA 通过可变速轨迹增强和速度条件，让同一个 VLA 可按阶段加速运输、减速接触，并由 VLM 动态调度执行节奏。
researchQuestion: 机器人任务在无接触移动阶段可以快，在插入和抓取阶段需要慢，但普通 VLA 只继承示范中的固定速度。模型压缩只能整体加快推理，无法让策略双向改变动作节奏。论文研究如何在不大改架构的情况下把速度变成可控条件。
contribution: 速度是机器人部署的重要控制维度，却长期被 VLA 当作数据副产物。TempoVLA 让策略可以在效率和精度之间按阶段切换，具有直接实用性。
abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of
organizations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
selectionReason: Clever and practical speed control mechanism for VLAs with minimal architectural changes; VSTA data augmentation is simple yet effective; VLM-driven dynamic scheduling opens new control dimensions.

title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
titleZh: HANDOFF：基于互补教师蒸馏的人形智能任务空间全身控制
oneLiner: HANDOFF 提出紧凑的 10 维任务空间命令接口，通过多教师知识蒸馏将运动跟踪、步态和防跌倒三个互补控制器融合为单一可部署策略，配合 VLM 驱动的智能规划器在 Unitree G1 上实现语言驱动的零样本全身移动操作。
researchQuestion: 人形机器人全身控制的核心瓶颈在于命令空间设计：现有控制器需要密集的运动学或空间参考轨迹，而任务规划器难以从语义目标自动生成这些底层指令。如何设计一个简洁、通用且表达力足够的命令接口，使高层规划与底层控制之间的信息传递不丢失关键语义，是推动人形机器人实际部署的关键问题。
contribution: HANDOFF 解决了一个系统层面的关键问题：如何让人形机器人的"大脑"（规划）和"小脑"（控制）高效对话。10 维命令接口有望成为人形机器人领域的标准化实践，类似于 ROS 中的 Twist 消息之于移动机器人。多教师互补蒸馏的思路也为复杂机器人系统的模块化开发与集成部署提供了新范式。
abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse loco-manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single hum
selectionReason: Transformative humanoid controller design with a compact, planner-friendly 10-D interface; multi-teacher distillation is elegant and extensible; promises open-source release; enables VLM-driven task execution without per-task data.

title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
titleZh: VISTA：面向 VLA 训练的 UMI 数据视觉锚定与物理验证适配
oneLiner: VISTA通过三个协同组件桥接UMI手持夹爪数据与通用VLA训练的视觉和物理鸿沟：UMI-VQA（800万对鱼眼视觉问答数据）、物理验证管线（过滤不可行轨迹）和两阶段联合训练，在仿真和真实操作任务上显著优于π₀.₅、LingBot-VLA和Wall-X。
researchQuestion: UMI和FastUMI通过手持夹爪接口提供了可扩展的真实数据采集途径，但将UMI数据用于训练大规模VLA模型面临两个根本性挑战：（1）视觉接地失配——腕戴鱼眼相机的局部、夹爪中心视角与VLM预训练的标准透视图像在投影几何、空间分辨率和自遮挡模式上存在巨大差异；（2）物理可行性缺失——人工采集的轨迹不受目标机器人运动学极限、碰撞约束和控制器带宽限制，可能包含运动学不可达位姿、自碰撞或超限运动。
contribution: UMI是近年来最具影响力的数据采集范式之一，VISTA首次系统解决了UMI数据与VLA模型之间的视觉和物理双重鸿沟。800万对鱼眼VQA数据的构建思路——用大规模视觉语言数据"教会"模型理解非标准视角——对其他传感器视角迁移问题具有启发意义。
abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, inc
selectionReason: Critical infrastructure for the widely-used UMI data collection paradigm; releases 8M fisheye VQA dataset, validation pipeline, and pre-trained model; strong empirical results across 20 real-world tasks.

title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Tasks
titleZh: HapTile：面向接触密集型任务的触觉感知视觉-触觉-语言-动作数据集
oneLiner: 首个同时提供语言条件、指尖触觉反馈和触觉遥操作界面的VLA数据集：1726条演示覆盖38个日常操作任务、9种接触密集型技能（750分钟交互），在UR5e+定制指尖视觉触觉传感器平台上采集，操作员可实时感知接触交互。
researchQuestion: 触觉感知对可靠操作至关重要，但现有VLA数据集多为纯视觉。包含触觉信息的数据集通常缺少任务多样性、语言条件和动作轨迹的联合组合。同时现有遥操作管线极少向操作员提供触觉反馈，尽管触觉对演示质量和操作稳定性有公认作用。填补这一空白是HapTile的核心动机。
contribution: HapTile填补了VLA数据集中触觉模态的关键空白。其触觉感知遥操作界面的设计理念——让操作员在采集演示时实时感知接触——对于提升接触密集型任务的演示质量具有重要参考价值。作为语言条件、触觉感知的统一数据集，HapTile为训练真正接触感知的VLA策略提供了基础设施。
abstract: Despite the importance of tactile sensing for reliable manipulation, most existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets remain vision-only, and those that do incorporate tactile information typically lack the joint combination of task diversity, language conditioning, and action trajectories. Furthermore, existing teleoperation pipelines rarely provide haptic feedback to the operator, despite its established role in demonstration quality and manipulation stability. In this work, we present HapTile, a contact-grounded visuotactile manipulation dataset that advances beyond vision-only trajectory datasets by embedding physical interaction sensing at two levels: fingertip tactile feedback at the robot end-effector, and haptic-informed demonstrations at the teleoperator side. The data collection platform integrates haptic feedback directly into the teleoperation controller, enabling the operator to perceive contact interactions in real time. It is built around a standard and reproducible robotic system equipped with custom-designed fingertip tactile sensors. The dataset comprises everyday manipulation tasks spanning a broad range of contact-rich skills, including pick-and-place, folding, pressing, stacking, and other routine activities. Each task is paired with language instructions that condition the policy on the manipulation objective, together with synchronized visuotactile observations and action trajectories.
selectionReason: 首个同时提供语言条件、指尖触觉反馈和触觉遥操作界面的VLA数据集。1726条演示覆盖38个日常操作任务和9种技能（移动、放置、移除、翻转、折叠、插入、擦拭、按压、堆叠），共750分钟交互。数据集在UR5e+Robotiq 2F-85+定制指尖视觉触觉传感器平台上采集，远程操作员可实时感知接触交互。填补了VLA数据集中触觉模态的空白。

title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
titleZh: M3imic：面向多模态运动模仿的通用全身人形控制器
oneLiner: M3imic提出多模态模仿框架，统一机器人关节角、人体姿态和末端执行器位姿三种运动参考模态，在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现99.54%成功率，揭示了稠密关节参考提升跟踪精度、稀疏末端参考增强鲁棒性的精度-鲁棒性权衡。
researchQuestion: 构建通用全身控制器是人形机器人实现多样化运动能力（包括运动和操作）的核心挑战。不同任务依赖不同的运动参考模态：运动主要靠关节轨迹，操作需精确的末端执行器轨迹跟踪。现有方法常忽略稠密机器人关节角与稀疏末端执行器位姿之间的表征失配问题。此外，多阶段蒸馏范式会引入信息损失、分布不匹配和累积误差。
contribution: 为通用人形机器人控制提供了统一的多模态框架，单阶段训练避免了蒸馏方案的信息损失。精度-鲁棒性权衡的发现对实际部署中模态选择具有重要指导意义。
abstract: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint a
selectionReason: Strong humanoid whole-body controller with multimodal motion mimicking. Unifies joint angles, human poses, and end-effector poses in one policy. 98.42% simulation success with sim-to-real on Unitree G1. Public code on GitHub is a significant plus. Fills humanoid whole-body control gap on the board.

title: WAM-Nav: Asymmetric Latent World-Action Modeling for Unified Visual Navigation
titleZh: WAM-Nav：用于统一视觉导航的非对称潜在世界—动作建模
oneLiner: WAM-Nav 用非对称联合扩散同时生成动作与潜在视觉未来，在一个策略中支持图像目标、点目标和无目标导航，并以 85% 成功率迁移到真实机器人。
researchQuestion: 反应式导航只根据当前观察输出动作，缺少预见性；模块化视频想象再规划会累积生成误差且推理慢。论文研究是否可以在同一模型中联合学习未来场景和动作，但让两个分支承担不同精度与条件。
contribution: WAM-Nav 展示世界模型不必生成可观看视频，也能以紧凑潜变量为动作提供预见性，是 WAM 在导航中的实用化方向。
abstract: Visual navigation requires generating smooth and collision-free trajectories under complex geometric and physical constraints. Existing reactive policies that directly map observations to actions lack anticipatory reasoning, limiting their ability to proactively avoid obstacles. While visual imagination offers predictive foresight, conventional modular approaches separate scene prediction from policy learning, often leading to error accumulation and inefficient inference. To address these limita
selectionReason: Solid navigation method with real-world validation; joint world-action modeling is an elegant approach but the navigation-only scope and lack of code release limit broader impact.

title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
titleZh: ForesightFlow：用势函数引导流匹配改进 VLA 策略
oneLiner: ForesightFlow 从混合质量部署数据中学习相对优势势函数，以解耦加权流匹配和一步边界估计实现无独立 critic 的 VLA 自改进。
researchQuestion: 部署轨迹同时包含成功、部分完成、可恢复错误与失败。全量 BC 会模仿错误，过滤 BC 丢掉有用子轨迹，离线 RL 又要训练大型 critic。论文研究如何利用 flow policy 自身学习“哪些动作更有前景”，同时避免价值估计过度自信。
contribution: 它给 flow-based VLA 提供了不丢弃失败经验、又不新增大 critic 的改进路线，适合持续收集真实 rollout 的系统。
abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-m
selectionReason: 巧妙地将流匹配(flow matching)引入VLA策略自改进，解决了混合质量部署数据的利用难题。核心贡献：(1)解耦优势加权流匹配——关键洞察是policy improvement和value calibration需要不同监督：动作速度用指数化优势权重强化高质量动作，潜在坐标均匀训练避免过度自信；(2)一步边界估计器从条件流边界恒等式推导，实现无额外critic的best-of-K推理；(3)训练计算减少38%。10个任务(5仿真+5真实双臂)验证。相较于看板中已有的RL-based改进方法，ForesightFlow从flow matching和自引导角度提供了全新的策略改进范式。代码已公开。主要风险：方法相对复杂(flow matching + advantage weighting + boundary estimation)，复现有一定门槛。

title: MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping
titleZh: MoDex：用于连续多物体灵巧抓取的扩散策略
oneLiner: MoDex 用 opposition space 指定本轮参与抓取的手指，保留其余自由度供后续物体使用，使单只 Allegro Hand 能在不释放已持物体的情况下连续抓取。
researchQuestion: 传统灵巧抓取往往为一个物体使用全部手指，抓住后就没有冗余继续操作。连续抓多个物体要求策略同时考虑当前目标、已持物体碰撞和未来可用手指。论文研究能否显式指定本轮的对置手指空间，让策略主动分配灵巧手自由度。
contribution: MoDex 提出一个很直接但容易被忽略的问题：灵巧性不仅是抓得更稳，也包括保留自由度供后续动作。它为长时序灵巧操作提供了资源分配视角。
abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. selectionReason: 首次解决单只灵巧手顺序抓取多个物体而不释放已持物体的问题。核心贡献：(1)Opposition space条件——指定参与当前抓取的手指；(2)两阶段训练（BC→RL微调）实现sim-to-real。仿真和真实Franka+Allegro Hand平台验证，较基线提升显著。为灵巧操作的多物体场景提供了新颖视角。主要风险：仅3个物体的顺序抓取展示，任务规模有限。

title: ConTrack: Constrained Hand Motion Tracking with Adaptive Trade-off Control
titleZh: ConTrack：具有自适应权衡控制的约束手部运动跟踪
oneLiner: ConTrack 把物体轨迹跟踪设为约束、把人类手部动作保真设为目标，并用在线对偶变量和自适应中途重置稳定学习千步级接触序列。
researchQuestion: 把人类示范迁移到机器人手时，既要让物体按目标运动，又希望保留人类关节和接触风格。固定奖励权重需要为每段序列调参，长轨迹前段失败还会让后段永远学不到。论文研究如何让策略自动分配“完成任务”和“像示范”之间的控制余量。
contribution: 它把“既完成任务又像人”从手工奖励权重变成在线约束分配问题，为从视频或动作捕捉迁移长时灵巧技能提供了更可诊断的训练方式。

title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation

researchQuestion: 长时操作把抓取与后续运动紧密耦合：任务失败时，很难判断是抓取本身不适合功能部位，还是规划器无法从该抓取完成动作。无差别重采数据会浪费成本，也可能优化错误模块。论文研究如何把失败轨迹转化为明确归因，再形成数据—训练闭环。

abstract: In robotic manipulation, the tight coupling between grasping and motion planning often obscures the true source of failure, leading to inefficient trial-and-error. To enable efficient long-horizon manipulation, we propose GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp. Given a failed manipulation trajectory, we learn a failure attributi
selectionReason: 提出GTP-FA框架——通过故障归因模型从失败轨迹中诊断失败模式，再诊断驱动优化抓取评分和规划数据收集。核心贡献：(1)任务导向的'抓取-然后-规划'两阶段框架；(2)故障归因模型可泛化到未见抓取；(3)诊断驱动优化同时改进两模块。跨RL/IL/扩散策略/VLA设置验证，具策略无关性优势。方法思想清晰，诊断-优化闭环设计具有通用价值。

organizations: Zhejiang Key Laboratory of Intelligent Medical Decision Support

contribution: 它把柔性操作从零散任务推进到可比较的算法实验室，并使一阶物理梯度和大规模合成数据都可用，是重要仿真基础设施。
abstract: We address the challenge of enabling robots to manipulate deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes, cables, and rubber bands. Prior work has primarily focused on narrow, task-specific problems, often relying on real-world demonstrations or handcrafted heuristics. Such approaches, however, struggle to scale to the wide variety of materials and tasks encountered in practice, and collecting sufficiently diverse real-world data is often impractical. title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
titleZh: Goal2Pixel：将导航目标落到图像像素
oneLiner: Goal2Pixel用图像中的可导航像素替代低层动作作为VLM与机器人运动的接口；在R2R-CE Val-Unseen达到54.1% SR、52.5% SPL，每回合仅7.75次VLM调用，相比直接动作预测的46.62次约少6倍。其主要增量是更清晰、低频的空间控制接口。
researchQuestion: 连续视觉语言导航需要把高层语言理解转换成低层运动。直接让 VLM 输出离散动作会产生高频调用、接口脆弱，也难以把空间意图清晰交给传统导航控制器。
contribution: Goal2Pixel用图像中的可导航像素替代低层动作作为VLM与机器人运动的接口；在R2R-CE Val-Unseen达到54.1% SR、52.5% SPL，每回合仅7.75次VLM调用，相比直接动作预测的46.62次约少6倍。其主要增量是更清晰、低频的空间控制接口。 综合评分：84/100。该分数来自作者作品回扫，时效性按历史回填计分，不代表近期新论文排序。
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos

contribution: 它将示范视频从“外观条件”转化为明确的空间动作线索，并对不可见部分保持克制，是低样本任务适配中很实用的设计。

As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. title: HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model

researchQuestion: 如何针对视觉—语言—动作模型中的关键瓶颈提出可验证的方法改进，并确认它在代表性机器人任务中的收益与边界？

abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.

title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation

abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

title: AR Forcing: Towards Long-Horizon Robot Navigation World Model

abstract: The diffusion based robot navigation world models are typically trained using parallel supervision, while autoregressive inference is employed during path planning. This results in a distribution shift between training and inference, which destabilizes the performance over long-horizon prediction. We propose AR Forcing, an autoregressive training strategy, which integrates the standard diffusion loss into the autoregressive training loop. At each step, the model uses its own predictions to update the context and optimize the single step noise prediction objective, thereby explicitly exposing the model to the inference state distribution during training. Our method does not require additional discriminators or distribution-matching losses, retains the original diffusion framework and sampler, and is easy to integrate. Experiments on multi-domain navigation datasets (RECON, SCAND, HuRoN, TartanDrive) show that compared with strong baselines, AR Forcing improved the consistency of generated images during long-horizon navigation and the accuracy of predicted trajectories, enhancing robustness of the model in complex known and unknown environments. We will release the code soon.

abstract: This paper presents a phase-conditioned, force-aware framework for robust deformable object manipulation. Standard imitation learning policies such as Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) rely on a Markovian assumption at inference, causing state aliasing when visually similar observations require contradictory actions and preventing autonomous recovery from execution failures. We address this with a closed-loop hierarchical architecture. A FiLM-conditioned ACT encoder modulates feature extraction based on the current task phase, enabling a single unified policy to produce phase-specific behaviors while sharing action dynamics across phases. A multi-modal phase predictor fusing visual, force, and pose feedback estimates the phase in real time, detecting contact failures that are invisible to vision alone and autonomously triggering recovery trajectories. The system is completed by a hybrid impedance controller for compliant execution and a haptic teleoperation interface for force-aware data collection. Ablation studies show that FiLM-based modulation significantly outperforms both unconditioned and token-level conditioned baselines, and t-SNE analysis confirms that FiLM induces well-separated, phase-specific feature representations. abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have achieved remarkable progress in robotic manipulation, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: a lack of 3D scene understanding. This deficiency manifests as three intertwined challenges: weak extraction of 3D spatial positions without enforcing multi-view consistency, inadequate 3D instance understanding, and fragile reasoning under occlusion. Although mature 3D perception methods exist, their direct integration into VLA pipelines is hindered by architectural incompatibility and by heavy reliance on costly instance-level annotations. Specifically, 3DVLA tackles the three challenges through: (1) pervasive 3D feature encoding with explicit multi-view consistency constraints across all modalities and a Spatially-Conditioned Geometry Aggregation method, (2) an instance estimation module with high-level instance tokens for 3D instance awareness, and (3) a masked self-supervised 3D encoding branch that retains its predictor for visual token completion to handle occlusions. We integrate 3DVLA with multiple VLA baselines and evaluate on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0. Results show consistent and significant gains in manipulation performance, validating both the effectiveness and plug-and-play compatibility of our approach.

abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic control. However, their high computational cost and limited control frequency hinder real-time robotic manipulation, especially when large vision-language backbones and iterative action heads run at every control step. Existing VLA acceleration methods often optimize individual components or rely on fixed acceleration rules, treating different control steps with largely fixed computation and overlooking the non-uniform reasoning demands of sequential embodied control. Inspired by human motor control, where cognitive and feedback resources concentrate on goal-sensitive stages, we argue that VLA models should learn when to invest full computation and when to reuse prior computation. ElegantVLA introduces a lightweight scheduler that observes temporal representation similarity, robot-motion cues, and episode progress to jointly allocate computation across the vision encoder, LLM, and action head. For perception-language reasoning, the scheduler selects a five-level Vision-LLM compute mode, from full recomputation to multi-step temporal reuse, based on visual-language representation stability. For action generation, it selects a three-level denoising mode, reusing intermediate denoising states during stable motion while preserving full refinement for goal-sensitive stages. By coordinating these decisions, ElegantVLA offers a general acceleration framework for modern VLA pipelines with explicit action-generation modules, without modifying or retraining the base model. abstract: Confidence estimation for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models is essential for robots to perform manipulation tasks in the open world, providing crucial signals for risk-sensitive decision-making and failure anticipation. abstract: Real-time inference of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for robotic control. While visual token pruning has shown strong potential for accelerating inference, most existing methods mainly base pruning decisions on shallow-layer cues and risk discarding visual information required by deep layers. We further introduce a reference timestep refresh strategy that triggers updates upon attention shifts, thereby improving forecasting accuracy and pruning reliability. abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise for robotic manipulation, yet most existing policies operate reactively by directly regressing actions from current observations, without explicitly modeling future dynamics. abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot manipulation by using video-based future representations to condition action generation. In pixel-space WAMs, however, the best action condition is not necessarily the fully denoised video. Controlled denoising-depth scans show that video refinement can reduce action error up to a state-dependent point, after which the gain may saturate or even reverse when late predictions become less action-relevant or physically unreliable. This suggests that action generation should use a state-dependent point along the video noise trajectory rather than a fixed terminal denoising depth. We introduce State-Adaptive Noise Trajectory Scheduler (SANTS), a lightweight scheduler for video-to-action diffusion policies. At each video decision point, SANTS reads the current video-state representation and noise level, then jointly predicts a cumulative stopping hazard and a relative noise-progression ratio. SANTS is post-trained with a path-level reward computed after the frozen action branch generates the final action chunk, so the scheduler is optimized for downstream action quality rather than intermediate video fidelity, while redundant video-state updates are explicitly penalized. Experiments show that SANTS reaches \(94.4\%\) overall success on RoboTwin 2.0 and \(73.1\%\) average success across seven real-robot tasks, while reducing latency by \(81.7\%\) and \(79.0\%\) relative to full video denoising, respectively. These results indicate that adaptive selection along the video noise trajectory can preserve the control benefits of WAM-style future reasoning while removing much of its redundant inference cost.

However, their control remains challenging due to indirect actuation, limited sensing, and nonlinear magnetic interactions. abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a promising foundation for general-purpose robotics, yet their real-world deployment demands the ability to continually acquire new skills without forgetting prior ones. While recent studies have explored continual learning for VLA models in simulated settings, the challenge remains largely unexamined under realistic physical conditions. To bridge this gap, we construct a real-world continual learning benchmark comprising ten diverse sequential manipulation tasks across both single-arm and bimanual configurations. Through extensive experiments on this benchmark, we find that naive sequential fine-tuning leads to severe catastrophic forgetting, whereas a well-configured experience replay (ER) approach can effectively mitigate forgetting and outperform joint multi-task training under equivalent computational budgets. Notably, by synthesizing our empirical findings, we successfully achieve stable continual learning across the full 10-task heterogeneous stream, retaining previously acquired capabilities while adapting to diverse new skills in real-world deployment. This work presents an empirical study grounded in real-world continual VLA learning and offers actionable insights for deploying robust, long-lived robotic policies.

abstract: Semantic mapping methods are increasingly used as intermediate scene representations for downstream robotic reasoning and manipulation, yet their evaluation is still largely tied to fixed benchmark datasets with limited coverage of manipulation-relevant corner cases. In this work, we extend OSMa-Bench toward controllable benchmarking with prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes. Our pipeline automatically generates scene descriptions, synthesizes corresponding environments with SceneSmith, and adapts the resulting assets into an OSMa-Bench-compatible simulation format. This adaptation requires a nontrivial intermediate layer, including semantic normalization, material and texture repair, shader fallback policies, floor handling, navigation setup, and controlled lighting configuration. A key advantage of the proposed setup is that the original scene-generation prompt is known in advance and can therefore serve as an auxiliary semantic specification of the intended scene. We use this property to extend the VQA component of OSMa-Bench with a prompt-grounded question category. The resulting framework supports targeted stress-testing of semantic scene representations under conditions such as clutter, small objects, partial occlusions, and lighting variation, and makes benchmarking more extensible and better aligned with downstream manipulation requirements. Our code is available at https://github.com/be2rlab/OSMa-Bench-v2.

abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly expected to not only complete robot tasks, but also follow human instructions about how those tasks should be executed. However, existing robot datasets usually pair trajectories with coarse goal-level language, leaving execution-critical details such as active arm, approach direction, and contact region unspecified. This limits steerable policy learning and robotic video understanding. We introduce FineVLA, an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision. The framework includes: (1) a data construction tool that unifies 972,247 trajectories across 85K tasks from 10 open-source robot datasets and builds FineVLA-Data, a human-verified dataset of 47,159 fine-grained trajectories; (2) a held-out benchmark with 500 videos, 11,631 atomic facts, and 1,030 VQA questions; (3) a robotics-specialized VLM annotator for scalable fine-grained annotation; and (4) a steerable VLA policy trained with controlled mixtures of fine-grained and raw goal-level instructions. Our experiments yield three findings. First, fine-grained supervision does not sacrifice goal-level success: FG-only improves over Raw-only by +1.4 to +8.1 success-rate points across settings. Second, fine-grained and raw instructions are complementary, following a consistent inverted-U trend peaking at FG:Raw = 1:2 to 1:1. The best mixed setting reaches 86.8%/82.5% in RoboTwin simulation and 62.7/100 in real-world dual-arm manipulation (vs. 49.9 Raw-only). Third, fine-grained supervision improves steerable control: the largest real-world gains appear on pose (+23), color (+18), and approach direction (+18)--factors where goal-level instructions provide no guidance. Overall, fine-grained language should augment goal-level instructions: specifying how to execute alongside what to achieve. Project page: https://finevla.xlang.ai/

abstract: Imitation learning is a promising approach for training humanoid robots to both walk and manipulate, but it requires a large number of demonstrations, which are time-intensive and difficult to collect via teleoperation. Existing data-generation algorithms can automatically synthesize demonstrations for manipulators, but they are ineffective on humanoids because their high-dimensional composite action spaces involve arms, legs, and torsos. We present HumanoidMimicGen, a method for generating humanoid legged loco-manipulation data. Our method adapts contact-rich whole-body skills from a handful of source demonstrations to new states, generalizing across changes in object pose. By interleaving these single- and dual-arm skills with whole-body locomotion and manipulation planning, the method generates stable, collision-free data across diverse scenes and layouts. To evaluate our approach, we introduce a new simulated loco-manipulation benchmark containing nine diverse tasks that test humanoid loco-manipulation capabilities. There, we demonstrate that HumanoidMimicGen automatically generates large datasets for imitation learning and enables a systematic study of how data generation and policy learning decisions impact model performance. We show that whole-body visuomotor policies co-trained with data generated by HumanoidMimicGen outperform those trained only on real-world data by 20%.

abstract: The ability to efficiently and reliably learn new tasks has been a foundational challenge in robotics. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse manipulation tasks, yet pretrained policies consistently fall short of the reliability required for real-world deployment. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches either train from scratch without fully leveraging pretrained priors, or fine-tune VLAs without achieving the sample efficiency and success rates that practical deployment demands. We present EXPO-FT, a system for stable, sample-efficient RL finetuning of pretrained VLA policies that closes this gap. Our system solves a suite of challenging manipulation tasks, including routing string lights and inserting the plug to light it up, striking a pool ball into a pocket, and inserting a flower into a wine bottle, each requiring combinations of high precision, dynamic actions, and robustness to varied initial states. Our system achieves perfect task performance (30/30 successes) across all evaluated tasks within an average of 19.1 minutes of online robot data, outperforming both prior RL-from-scratch and VLA finetuning approaches. We release an open-source codebase with the aim of facilitating broader adoption of RL finetuning of VLA models in robotics.

abstract: Learning universal policies from cross-embodied data remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are pre-trained on large and diverse datasets, they typically rely on embodiment-specific fine-tuning to achieve strong performance in downstream tasks. This requirement severely limits their generalization capability and restricts knowledge transfer across embodiments performing similar tasks. To overcome these limitations, we focus on cross-embodied settings with shared robotic bases and heterogeneous end-effectors, and propose X-DiffVLA, a diffusion-based VLA model featuring a unified cross-embodied action head. X-DiffVLA can leverage the generative strengths of diffusion models to capture both the diversity and latent correlations in cross-embodied datasets. Specifically, we introduce Embodiment Forcing, a classifier-free guidance technique to implicitly steer action generation toward embodiment-specific functional components, capturing fine-grained structural nuances without explicit supervision. In addition, a Morphological Tree Diffusion approach is designed to strengthen behavioral correlations across diverse end-effectors, maximizing the transferability of heterogeneous demonstrations. Experimental results across RoboCasa and Isaac Gym, covering different embodiments from grippers to dexterous hands, show that X-DiffVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improvements of 15.3% and 12.5%, respectively. Real-world evaluations further validate the robustness of the proposed framework and its effectiveness in scalable cross-embodied policy learning.
